- **One workspace, one story** (Rupsha Knitwear). The approval level set in "approval and posting" holds for every
  test after it, and the bill numbers count up across the file. When a test fails, read the first failure first.
- **Four people, each for one rule.** Nasir is the Owner: his orders are approved the moment he submits them, so
  the file starts from approved orders, and his bills post at once (an Owner approves by submitting). Shirin, the
  accountant, books the bills. Kamal, the finance manager, is the one level of the bills' approval. Jamal, the store
  keeper, receives the goods and is the person the 403 test needs: he signed for the goods, he does not book the
  bill (decision 42).
- **The roles get names of their own** ("Bills desk", "Gate store"): the garments template already has an
  "Accountant" and a "Store keeper", and a second role with the same name is `role_name_taken`.
- **Two stores of two branches** (main and Ashulia), so one bill clears "goods received not billed" for two
  branches (decision 20).
- **Four suppliers, each a kind of bill:** the mill (45 days, orders), the dyeing house (15 days, a services-only
  order), the thread shop (0 days, no order) and the landlord (expenses only).
- **Four orders:** A buys twill and buttons at 45 days, C the mill's carriage at 30 days (a bill of both is due by
  the shorter, decision 39), D the dyeing, and E another carriage priced with VAT, to show that one bill cannot read
  prices both ways.
- **Two goods receipts:** 600 m of twill and 10 boxes of buttons into the main store, 400 m into Ashulia.
- **`receiptBillLine()` and `serviceBillLine()` fill a line the way the bill form does** when it adds a receipt line
  or an order's service line: the receipt's unit and quantity, the order's unit, quantity, price and VAT rate. The
  test then types only the price the supplier charged.
- **`formOf()` builds the edit form from a saved bill.** It cuts the API's four decimals to the form's two, and it
  does not send back the order line a stored receipt line keeps a copy of: the contract refuses a line that names
  both (`bill_line_source`).
- **`entryLines()` sorts the entry's lines** and names the branch (`HO` or `ASH`): the entry is summed per account
  and branch, and the order of its lines is not what the tests are about.
- **`toBill()` and `servicesToBill()` are the bill form's two lists:** the goods receipts with a line to bill, and
  the orders with a service to bill.

### A bill of goods receipts

```ts
describe('a bill of goods receipts', () => {
  it('starts from what the form offers: the receipts and the services still to bill', async () => {
    expect([grn1.number, grn2.number, grn1.billState]).toEqual([
      'GRN-2026-27-0001',
      'GRN-2026-27-0002',
      'not_billed',
    ]);
    expect(await toBill(mill)).toEqual([
      ['GRN-2026-27-0002', 'not_billed'],
      ['GRN-2026-27-0001', 'not_billed'],
    ]);
    expect(await toBill(dyer)).toEqual([]);
    // Goods are billed from their receipts, so an order offers only its services
    expect(await servicesToBill(mill)).toEqual([orderE.number, orderC.number]);
    expect(await servicesToBill(dyer)).toEqual([orderD.number]);
  });

  it("is priced line by line, shows where it differs from the order's price, and is due by the shortest terms", async () => {
    // The mill bills ৳315 a metre for what was ordered at ৳312.50: ৳1,500 more on 600 m
    bill1 = await billed(
      billForm(
        mill,
        [
          receiptBillLine(grn1, twill, '315'),
          receiptBillLine(grn2, twill, '312.50'),
          serviceBillLine(orderC, carriage),
        ],
        {
          supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0412',
          mushakNumber: '0412',
          mushakDate: '2026-10-15',
        },
      ),
    );
    expect(bill1).toMatchObject({
      number: null,
      status: 'draft',
      supplier: { name: 'Nayapara Weaving Mills' },
      supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0412',
      mushakNumber: '0412',
      mushakDate: '2026-10-15',
      // 16 Oct plus the shorter of the two orders' terms (45 and 30 days)
      dueDate: '2026-11-15',
      pricesIncludeVat: false,
      net: '319000.0000',
      vat: '47850.0000',
      total: '366850.0000',
      amountPaid: '0.0000',
      priceDifference: '1500.0000',
      // Nothing of its own to receive
      warehouseId: null,
      lineCount: 3,
      entry: null,
      approval: { rounds: [] },
    });
    expect(
      bill1.lines.map((line) => [
        line.receiptNumber,
        line.orderNumber,
        line.net,
        line.orderValue,
        codeOf(line.accountId),
      ]),
    ).toEqual([
      ['GRN-2026-27-0001', orderA.number, '189000.0000', '187500.0000', null],
      ['GRN-2026-27-0002', orderA.number, '125000.0000', '125000.0000', null],
      // An empty account is Settings → Purchase's "Purchased services", stored as the line's own
      [null, orderC.number, '5000.0000', null, '5170'],
    ]);
    expect(bill1.receipts.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual([grn1.number, grn2.number]);
    expect(bill1.orders.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual([orderA.number, orderC.number]);
    // A draft holds nothing: the receipts and the carriage are still offered
    expect(await toBill(mill)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(await servicesToBill(mill)).toContain(orderC.number);
  });

  it("refuses by the contract's rules first, then by what is true, each under its line", async () => {
    const twillLine = receiptBillLine(grn1, twill, '315');
    const rules = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [{ ...twillLine, orderLineId: orderLineOf(orderC, carriage) }, twillLine], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0413',
        dueDate: '2026-10-01',
        mushakDate: '2026-10-15',
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(rules.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(problemOf(rules).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.orderLineId': ['bill_line_source'],
      'lines.1.receiptLineId': ['bill_line_twice'],
      dueDate: ['bill_due_date'],
      mushakNumber: ['bill_mushak_number_required'],
    });
    const empty = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [], { supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0413' }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(empty).fieldErrors).toEqual({ lines: ['purchase_lines_required'] });

    // A receipt line is billed whole; goods on an order come through their receipt; a service
    // line is billed as ordered
    const lines = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(
        mill,
        [
          receiptBillLine(grn1, twill, '315', { quantity: '500' }),
          billLine(buttons, '10', '150', {
            unitId: unitId('box'),
            orderLineId: orderLineOf(orderA, buttons),
          }),
          serviceBillLine(orderC, carriage, { quantity: '2' }),
        ],
        { supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0413' },
      ),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(lines.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(lines).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.quantity': ['bill_receipt_line_quantity'],
      'lines.1.orderLineId': ['bill_order_line_invalid'],
      'lines.2.orderLineId': ['bill_order_line_invalid'],
    });
    // Another supplier's goods receipt, and another supplier's order
    const theirs = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(dyer, [receiptBillLine(grn2, twill, '312.50'), serviceBillLine(orderC, carriage)], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'SDW-118',
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(theirs).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.receiptLineId': ['bill_receipt_line_invalid'],
      'lines.1.orderLineId': ['bill_order_line_invalid'],
    });

    // The accounts only the system posts to: cash, goods received not billed, VAT input, the
    // payable, and a group
    const books = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [serviceBillLine(orderC, carriage, { accountId: accountId('2110') })], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0413',
        expenses: [
          expense('1110', 'Loading charge', '500'),
          expense('2115', 'Loading charge', '500'),
          expense('1170', 'Loading charge', '500'),
          expense('5200', 'Loading charge', '500'),
          expense('5240', 'Loading charge', '500'),
        ],
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(books).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.accountId': ['bill_account_invalid'],
      'expenses.0.accountId': ['bill_account_invalid'],
      'expenses.1.accountId': ['bill_account_invalid'],
      'expenses.2.accountId': ['bill_account_invalid'],
      'expenses.3.accountId': ['bill_account_invalid'],
    });

    // One bill reads its prices one way
    const mixed = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [receiptBillLine(grn1, twill, '315'), serviceBillLine(orderE, carriage)], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0413',
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(mixed).code).toBe('bill_vat_mixed');

    // The store keeper signed for the goods; booking the bill is the accountant's job
    const notHis = await send('POST', '/bills', billForm(mill, [twillLine]), jamal);
    expect(notHis.statusCode).toBe(403);
  });

  it("takes the supplier's bill number once, whatever its case and spaces", async () => {
    const twice = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [serviceBillLine(orderE, carriage)], {
        supplierBillNumber: ' nwm/2026/0412 ',
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(twice.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(twice).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      supplierBillNumber: ['bill_supplier_number_taken'],
    });
    // Another supplier may use the same number
    const other = await billed(
      billForm(dyer, [serviceBillLine(orderD, dyeing)], { supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0412' }),
    );
    // A draft nobody submitted is deleted, and its number is free again
    const removed = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/bills/${other.id}?version=${String(other.version)}`,
      undefined,
      shirin,
    );
    expect(removed.statusCode).toBe(204);
    expect((await send('GET', `/bills/${other.id}`)).statusCode).toBe(404);
  });
});
```

- **The form offers the receipts and the services, not the goods on an order:** an order's goods are billed through
  their receipt (decision 4), so the order list has only the orders with a service line to bill.
- **The mill's bill** is ৳3,19,000 + ৳47,850 VAT = ৳3,66,850: 600 m at ৳315 (৳1,89,000, which the receipt booked at
  ৳1,87,500), 400 m at the order's ৳312.50 and ৳5,000 of carriage. `priceDifference` is ৳1,500 and each receipt line
  shows its `orderValue`. The carriage's empty account became 5170 "Purchased services" and was stored (decision
  38). It is due on 15 Nov: 16 Oct plus 30 days, the shorter of the two orders' terms.
- **A draft holds nothing** (decision 29): both receipts and the carriage are still offered.
- **The contract's rules come first, as a 400:** a line that names a receipt line and an order line, the same
  receipt line twice, a due date before the bill's date, a Mushak date without its number, a bill with nothing on
  it.
- **Then what only the server knows, each under its line:** 500 m billed of a 600 m receipt line (billed whole),
  the buttons named as an order line (goods come through their receipt), a carriage of 2 when 1 was ordered, and
  another supplier's receipt line and order line. The accounts only the system posts to (cash, goods received not
  billed, VAT input, the payable) and a group are `bill_account_invalid` (decision 40); a transport expense (5240)
  is fine.
- **One bill reads its prices one way:** a receipt line of an order before VAT and a service of an order with VAT
  are `bill_vat_mixed`.
- **The supplier's number is once per supplier** (decisions 9 and 34): " nwm/2026/0412 " is the mill's
  "NWM/2026/0412" again. The dyeing house may use the same number. A draft that was never submitted is deleted.

### Approval and posting

```ts
describe('approval and posting', () => {
  it('waits for the finance manager from ৳1,00,000, numbered when submitted', async () => {
    const rule = await send('PUT', '/approval-rules/bill', {
      levels: [{ minAmount: '100000', roleId: financeManager.id }],
      version: 0,
    });
    expect(rule.statusCode, rule.body).toBe(200);
    const { items } = approvalRuleListSchema.parse((await send('GET', '/approval-rules')).json());
    expect(items.map((item) => [item.document, item.levels.length])).toEqual([
      ['requisition', 0],
      ['purchase_order', 0],
      ['bill', 1],
      ['supplier_payment', 0],
    ]);

    bill1 = await acted('submit', bill1);
    expect(bill1).toMatchObject({ number: 'BILL-2026-27-0001', status: 'pending' });
    expect(bill1.approval.rounds[0]).toMatchObject({
      status: 'pending',
      amount: '366850.0000',
      submittedBy: { name: 'Shirin Akter' },
      steps: [{ position: 1, role: { name: 'Finance manager' }, decision: null }],
    });
    // A pending bill is not changed; its writer does not approve it
    const late = await send('PUT', `/bills/${bill1.id}`, formOf(bill1), shirin);
    expect(problemOf(late).code).toBe('purchase_not_draft');
    expect(problemOf(await decide(bill1, 'approve', '', shirin)).code).toBe(
      'approval_own_document',
    );
    const waiting = waitingApprovalPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', '/approvals/waiting', undefined, kamal)).json(),
    );
    expect(waiting.items).toMatchObject([
      {
        document: 'bill',
        id: bill1.id,
        number: 'BILL-2026-27-0001',
        subject: 'Nayapara Weaving Mills',
        amount: '366850.0000',
      },
    ]);
    // Pending holds nothing either: it is posted only by the approval
    expect(await toBill(mill)).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('fails the approval when the posting fails, and decides nothing', async () => {
    const lock = await send('PUT', '/period-lock', { lockDate: '2026-10-16', version: 0 });
    expect(lock.statusCode, lock.body).toBe(200);
    const refused = await decide(bill1, 'approve');
    expect(refused.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(refused).code).toBe('journal_period_locked');
    const still = await billNow(bill1.id);
    expect(still).toMatchObject({ status: 'pending', entry: null, version: bill1.version });
    expect(still.approval.rounds[0]).toMatchObject({
      status: 'pending',
      steps: [{ decision: null }],
    });
    expect((await receiptNow(grn1.id)).lines.map((line) => line.billed)).toEqual([false, false]);
    const unlock = await send('PUT', '/period-lock', { lockDate: '', version: 1 });
    expect(unlock.statusCode, unlock.body).toBe(200);
  });

  it('posts at the last approval: goods received not billed per branch, the difference, the service, VAT and the payable', async () => {
    const approved = await decide(bill1, 'approve', 'Checked against the mill’s PI');
    expect(approved.statusCode, approved.body).toBe(204);
    bill1 = await billNow(bill1.id);
    expect(bill1).toMatchObject({ status: 'posted', number: 'BILL-2026-27-0001' });
    expect(bill1.postedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(bill1.approval.rounds[0]?.status).toBe('approved');
    expect(await entryLines(bill1.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '47850.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '0.0000', '366850.0000', 'HO'],
      // Each receipt's own branch: the account clears to zero branch by branch
      ['2115', '125000.0000', '0.0000', 'ASH'],
      ['2115', '187500.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5170', '5000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5180', '1500.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    const entry = journalEntrySchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${bill1.entry?.id ?? ''}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(entry).toMatchObject({ source: 'purchase_bill', narration: 'Bill BILL-2026-27-0001' });
    expect(entry.lines.find((line) => codeOf(line.accountId) === '2110')?.party?.id).toBe(mill.id);

    // The receipts: Ashulia's is billed; the main store's still has its buttons to bill
    const first = await receiptNow(grn1.id);
    expect([first.billState, first.lines.map((line) => line.billed)]).toEqual([
      'partly_billed',
      [true, false],
    ]);
    expect(first.bills.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual(['BILL-2026-27-0001']);
    expect((await receiptNow(grn2.id)).billState).toBe('billed');
    expect(await toBill(mill)).toEqual([['GRN-2026-27-0001', 'partly_billed']]);
    // The carriage is billed: only the order priced with VAT has a service to bill
    expect(await servicesToBill(mill)).toEqual([orderE.number]);
    const order = await orderNow(orderA.id);
    expect(order.lines.map((line) => line.billedQuantity)).toEqual(['1000.0000', '0.0000']);
    expect(order.bills.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual(['BILL-2026-27-0001']);
  });

  it('bills a receipt line in any unit of its item, and the receipt is billed', async () => {
    // 10 boxes came in; the mill bills 1,440 pieces at ৳1.05: ৳12 over the order's ৳1,500.
    // Below ৳1,00,000, so "Post" posts it at once.
    const line = receiptLineOf(grn1, buttons);
    const small = await billed(
      billForm(mill, [billLine(buttons, '1440', '1.05', { receiptLineId: line.id })], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0418',

    expect(small).toMatchObject({
      number: 'BILL-2026-27-0002',
      status: 'posted',
      net: '1512.0000',

      approval: { rounds: [{ status: 'approved', steps: [] }] },
    });
    expect(await entryLines(small.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '226.8000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '0.0000', '1738.8000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '1500.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5180', '12.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    expect((await receiptNow(grn1.id)).billState).toBe('billed');
    expect(await toBill(mill)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await orderNow(orderA.id)).lines.map((item) => item.billedQuantity)).toEqual([
      '1000.0000',
      '1440.0000',
    ]);
    // Billed once: the form would not offer it, and a bill typed by hand is refused
    const again = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(
        mill,
        [billLine(buttons, '10', '150', { unitId: unitId('box'), receiptLineId: line.id })],
        {
          supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0419',
        },
      ),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(again).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.receiptLineId': ['bill_receipt_line_billed'],
    });
  });

  it('goes back to draft when rejected, and a cancelled bill lets its number go', async () => {
    // The landlord's rent: an expense, no product. ৳1,38,000 with VAT, so Kamal decides.
    let rent = await billed(
      billForm(landlord, [], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'HKP-10/2026',
        expenses: [expense('5220', 'Factory rent, October 2026', '120000')],
        submit: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(rent).toMatchObject({
      number: 'BILL-2026-27-0003',
      status: 'pending',
      net: '120000.0000',
      total: '138000.0000',
    });
    expect(rent.expenses).toMatchObject([
      { description: 'Factory rent, October 2026', net: '120000.0000', vat: '18000.0000' },
    ]);
    const rejected = await decide(rent, 'reject', 'The new rent is ৳1,10,000 from October');
    expect(rejected.statusCode, rejected.body).toBe(204);
    rent = await billNow(rent.id);
    expect(rent).toMatchObject({ status: 'draft', number: 'BILL-2026-27-0003' });
    expect(rent.approval.rounds[0]).toMatchObject({
      status: 'rejected',
      steps: [{ decision: 'rejected', comment: 'The new rent is ৳1,10,000 from October' }],
    });
    // Changed and submitted again: round 2, for the new total
    const changed = await send(
      'PUT',
      `/bills/${rent.id}`,
      formOf(rent, {
        expenses: [expense('5220', 'Factory rent, October 2026', '110000')],
        submit: true,
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(changed.statusCode, changed.body).toBe(200);
    rent = billSchema.parse(changed.json());
    expect(rent.approval.rounds.map((round) => [round.status, round.amount])).toEqual([
      ['pending', '126500.0000'],
      ['rejected', '138000.0000'],
    ]);
    // Taken back: the round ends as reopened, the number stays, so it is not deleted
    rent = await acted('reopen', rent);
    expect(rent.approval.rounds[0]?.status).toBe('reopened');
    const remove = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/bills/${rent.id}?version=${String(rent.version)}`,
      undefined,
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(remove).code).toBe('purchase_was_submitted');
    // Cancelled while waiting: reopened first, in the same step
    rent = await acted('submit', rent);
    rent = await acted('cancel', rent);
    expect(rent).toMatchObject({ status: 'cancelled', number: 'BILL-2026-27-0003' });
    expect(rent.approval.rounds[0]?.status).toBe('reopened');
    expect(problemOf(await act('reopen', rent)).code).toBe('purchase_cannot_reopen');
    expect(problemOf(await act('submit', rent)).code).toBe('purchase_not_draft');
    const waiting = waitingApprovalPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', '/approvals/waiting', undefined, kamal)).json(),
    );
    expect(waiting.items).toEqual([]);

    // The landlord's corrected bill uses the same number. The Owner approves by submitting.
    const right = await billed(
      billForm(landlord, [], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'HKP-10/2026',
        expenses: [expense('5220', 'Factory rent, October 2026', '110000')],
        submit: true,
      }),
      owner,
    );
    expect(right).toMatchObject({ number: 'BILL-2026-27-0004', status: 'posted' });
    expect(await entryLines(right.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '16500.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '0.0000', '126500.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5220', '110000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    // An unnumbered draft is deleted, not cancelled
    const draft = await billed(
      billForm(landlord, [], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'HKP-11/2026',
        expenses: [expense('5220', 'Factory rent, November 2026', '110000')],
      }),
    );
    expect(problemOf(await act('cancel', draft)).code).toBe('purchase_delete_instead');
    expect(
      (
        await send(
          'DELETE',
          `/bills/${draft.id}?version=${String(draft.version)}`,
          undefined,
          shirin,
        )
      ).statusCode,
    ).toBe(204);
  });
});
```

- **Bills have their own levels:** from ৳1,00,000 the finance manager. The rules list has the four kinds, each from
  version 0.
- **Submitting numbers the bill** (`BILL-2026-27-0001`, decision 13) and starts a round for its total. A pending
  bill is not changed, Shirin does not approve her own bill (`approval_own_document`), and Kamal sees it with the
  mill's name as its subject. Pending holds nothing either.
- **A posting that fails fails the approval** (decision 36). With the books closed up to 16 Oct, Kamal's approval is
  `journal_period_locked`, and nothing moved: the bill is pending with the same version, the step is undecided,
  the receipt lines are not billed. We reopened the period and approved again.
- **The last approval posts it.** The entry: Dr 2115 ৳1,87,500 for the main branch and ৳1,25,000 for Ashulia, each
  receipt's own branch; Dr 5180 ৳1,500; Dr 5170 ৳5,000; Dr 1170 ৳47,850; Cr 2110 ৳3,66,850 with the mill as its
  party.
- **The receipts and orders count it:** Ashulia's receipt is "billed", the main store's "partly billed" (its buttons
  are not), and it is the only one the form still offers. Order A shows 1,000 m billed and the bill; order C no
  longer has a service to bill.
- **A receipt line is billed in any unit of its item:** 10 boxes came in, the mill bills 1,440 pieces at ৳1.05,
  ৳12 over the order. Below ৳1,00,000, so "Post" posts it at once, with a round that is approved and has no steps.
  Now the receipt is "billed", nothing is left to bill, and a bill that names the line again is
  `bill_receipt_line_billed` when it is saved.
- **Rejected, a bill goes back to draft with its number.** Changed and submitted again it starts round 2, for the
  new total. Reopened, its round ends as "reopened" and the bill is not deleted (`purchase_was_submitted`).
  Cancelled while pending, it is reopened first in the same step (decision 31), so nothing waits in Kamal's list.
  A cancelled bill is not reopened or submitted, and it lets its supplier number go: the landlord's corrected bill
  uses the same number. A draft nobody submitted is deleted, not cancelled.

### An order's services

```ts
describe("an order's services", () => {
  it('hold the order while a bill bills them, are billed once, and let a services-only order close', async () => {
    let dyed = await billed(
      billForm(dyer, [serviceBillLine(orderD, dyeing, { accountId: accountId('5140') })], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'SDW-0091',
      }),
    );
    // 15 days: the order's terms
    expect(dyed.dueDate).toBe('2026-10-31');
    // A draft bill of its service: the order is not reopened or cancelled under it
    orderD = await orderNow(orderD.id);
    for (const action of ['reopen', 'cancel'] as const) {
      const res = await send('POST', `/purchase-orders/${orderD.id}/${action}`, {
        version: orderD.version,
      });
      expect(problemOf(res).code).toBe('purchase_order_billed');
    }
    dyed = await acted('submit', dyed);
    expect(dyed).toMatchObject({ number: 'BILL-2026-27-0005', status: 'posted' });
    expect(await entryLines(dyed.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '6000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '0.0000', '46000.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5140', '40000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    // Once posted, the service is billed: a second bill is refused when it is saved
    const twice = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(dyer, [serviceBillLine(orderD, dyeing)], { supplierBillNumber: 'SDW-0092' }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(twice).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.orderLineId': ['bill_order_line_billed'],
    });
    expect(await servicesToBill(dyer)).toEqual([]);
    // Services never get a goods receipt: the posted bill lets the order close
    orderD = await orderNow(orderD.id);
    expect(orderD.lines.map((line) => line.billedQuantity)).toEqual(['1.0000']);
    const closed = await send('POST', `/purchase-orders/${orderD.id}/close`, {
      version: orderD.version,
    });
    expect(closed.statusCode, closed.body).toBe(200);
    expect(purchaseOrderSchema.parse(closed.json()).status).toBe('closed');
  });
});
```

- **A draft bill holds its order** (decision 30): while it bills the dyeing, order D is not reopened or cancelled
  (`purchase_order_billed`). Its due date is the order's 15 days.
- **Billed once:** after the bill is posted, a second bill for the same service is refused when it is saved, and
  the order has nothing left to bill.
- **A services-only order closes** once a posted bill billed it: it never gets a goods receipt.

### A bill with no order

```ts
describe('a bill with no order', () => {
  it('checks its own goods like a goods receipt', async () => {
    const own = billLine(thread, '200', '95', { lotNumber: 'TH-2610' });
    const noStore = await send(

      '/bills',
      billForm(threadShop, [own], { supplierBillNumber: 'BTH-5521' }),

    const wrongFields = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(
        threadShop,
        [
          { ...own, accountId: accountId('5290') },
          billLine(servicing, '1', '3000', { lotNumber: 'GEN-1' }),

    expect(problemOf(wrongFields).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.accountId': ['bill_account_not_allowed'],
      'lines.1.lotNumber': ['bill_stock_not_allowed'],
    });
    // A lot for a product kept by lot, checked by the goods receipt's own rules, under its line
    const noLot = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(threadShop, [billLine(servicing, '1', '3000'), { ...own, lotNumber: '' }], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'BTH-5521',
        warehouseId: main.id,
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(noLot).fieldErrors).toEqual({ 'lines.1.lotNumber': ['stock_lot_required'] });
  });

  it('receives its own goods when it is posted, on a goods receipt of its own', async () => {
    // 200 cones at ৳95, the mechanic's visit (to Purchased services) and the alternator repair
    // (an expense): ৳30,000 + ৳4,500 VAT, posted at once
    const shop = await billed(
      billForm(
        threadShop,
        [billLine(thread, '200', '95', { lotNumber: 'TH-2610' }), billLine(servicing, '1', '3000')],
        {
          supplierBillNumber: 'BTH-5521',
          warehouseId: main.id,
          expenses: [expense('5270', 'Generator repair, burnt alternator', '8000')],
          submit: true,
        },
      ),
    );
    expect(shop).toMatchObject({
      number: 'BILL-2026-27-0006',
      status: 'posted',
      // 0 days: due the day it is dated
      dueDate: '2026-10-16',
      warehouseId: main.id,
      net: '30000.0000',
      vat: '4500.0000',
      total: '34500.0000',
      priceDifference: '0.0000',
    });
    const [threadLine, serviceLine] = shop.lines;
    expect(threadLine).toMatchObject({
      receiptNumber: 'GRN-2026-27-0003',
      orderNumber: null,
      orderValue: null,
      lotNumber: 'TH-2610',
    });
    expect(threadLine?.batchId).not.toBeNull();
    expect(codeOf(serviceLine?.accountId ?? null)).toBe('5170');
    expect(shop.receipts.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual(['GRN-2026-27-0003']);

    // The receipt the bill made: no order, the bill's, billed, and not offered to another bill
    const page = goodsReceiptPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/goods-receipts?supplierId=${threadShop.id}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(page.items).toMatchObject([
      {
        number: 'GRN-2026-27-0003',
        order: null,
        bill: { id: shop.id, number: 'BILL-2026-27-0006' },
        status: 'posted',
        billState: 'billed',
      },
    ]);
    const made = await receiptNow(page.items[0]?.id ?? '');
    expect(made.lines).toMatchObject([{ orderLineId: null, billed: true, value: '19000.0000' }]);
    expect(await toBill(threadShop)).toEqual([]);
    // It came in at the bill's net, and the bill cleared what the receipt owed
    expect(await entryLines(made.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1154', '19000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '0.0000', '19000.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    expect(await entryLines(shop.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '4500.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '0.0000', '34500.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '19000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5170', '3000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5270', '8000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    const card = stockCardSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/stock/variants/${variantOf(thread)}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(card.item.onHand).toBe('200.0000');
  });

  it("teaches the cost lookup the shop's price", async () => {
    const res = await send('POST', '/purchase/cost-lookup', {
      supplierId: threadShop.id,
      items: [{ variantId: variantOf(thread), unitId: unitId('pcs') }],
    });
    expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
    expect(costLookupSchema.parse(res.json()).items).toMatchObject([
      { cost: '95.0000', source: 'supplier_price' },
    ]);
  });
});
```

- **Its own goods are checked like a goods receipt's:** a warehouse is needed, a goods line takes no account and a
  service line no lot, and a product kept by lot needs one (`stock_lot_required`, the receipt's own code, under the
  bill's line number: `onBillLines()` maps the receipt's `lines.0` to the bill's `lines.1`).
- **Posted, the bill receives its goods** on a goods receipt of its own (decision 4): `GRN-2026-27-0003`, with no
  order, the bill as its `bill`, "billed", and never offered to another bill. Its entry is Dr 1154 / Cr 2115 ৳19,000,
  at the bill's net, and the bill's own entry clears the same ৳19,000 from 2115. The thread is in stock, by lot.
- **The cost lookup learns the shop's price** (decision 25): ৳95, as this supplier's price.

### Settings → Purchase

```ts
describe('Settings → Purchase', () => {
  it('starts with the two accounts of the chart, which stay while chosen', async () => {
    const chosen = purchaseAccountsSchema.parse((await send('GET', '/purchase-accounts')).json());
    expect([codeOf(chosen.priceDifference), codeOf(chosen.services)]).toEqual(['5180', '5170']);
    const services = accounts.find((item) => item.code === '5170');
    const archive = await send('POST', `/accounts/${accountId('5170')}/archive`, {
      version: services?.version ?? 0,
    });
    expect(problemOf(archive).code).toBe('account_used_by_purchase');
    // Settings are the Owner's (core.settings.manage), and only an expense ledger fits
    const notHers = await send(
      'PUT',
      '/purchase-accounts',
      { priceDifference: '', services: '' },
      shirin,
    );
    expect(notHers.statusCode).toBe(403);
    const cash = await send('PUT', '/purchase-accounts', {
      priceDifference: accountId('1110'),
      services: accountId('5170'),
    });
    expect(problemOf(cash).code).toBe('purchase_account_invalid');
  });

  it('with none chosen, a service line needs its own account and a difference goes to cost of goods sold', async () => {
    const cleared = await send('PUT', '/purchase-accounts', { priceDifference: '', services: '' });
    expect(cleared.statusCode, cleared.body).toBe(200);
    expect(purchaseAccountsSchema.parse(cleared.json())).toEqual({
      priceDifference: null,
      services: null,
    });
    const noAccount = await send(
      'POST',
      '/bills',
      billForm(mill, [serviceBillLine(orderE, carriage)], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'NWM/2026/0430',
        pricesIncludeVat: true,
      }),
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(noAccount).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.accountId': ['bill_account_required'],
    });
  });
});
```

- **The setup job chose 5180 and 5170** (decision 41). A chosen account is not archived (`account_used_by_purchase`).
  Only the Owner changes them, and cash is not an expense account.
- **With none chosen,** a service line with no account of its own is `bill_account_required` (decision 16).

### Two bills at the same moment

```ts
describe('two bills at the same moment', () => {
  it('bill a receipt line once: the second waits, then finds it billed, and uses no number', async () => {
    const orderF = await approvedOrder(mill, [orderLine(twill, '100', '300')]);
    const grn3 = await received(orderF, main, [{ product: twill, quantity: '100' }]);
    // Two clerks type the same delivery note at ৳310 a metre (৳1,000 over the order)
    const [a, b] = await Promise.all(
      ['NWM/2026/0450', 'NWM/2026/0451'].map((number) =>
        billed(
          billForm(mill, [receiptBillLine(grn3, twill, '310')], { supplierBillNumber: number }),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (!a || !b) throw new Error('two drafts expected');
    const [first, second] = await Promise.all([act('submit', a), act('submit', b)]);
    const codes = [first, second].map((res) =>
      res.statusCode === 200 ? 'posted' : problemOf(res).code,
    );
    expect(codes.toSorted()).toEqual(['bill_receipt_line_billed', 'posted']);
    const winner = first.statusCode === 200 ? a : b;
    const loser = winner === a ? b : a;
    const posted = await billNow(winner.id);
    expect(posted.number).toBe('BILL-2026-27-0007');
    // Settings → Purchase has no price difference account now: the difference is a cost of sale
    expect(await entryLines(posted.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['1170', '4650.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2110', '0.0000', '35650.0000', 'HO'],
      ['2115', '30000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
      ['5110', '1000.0000', '0.0000', 'HO'],
    ]);
    // The loser rolled back whole: still a draft, no number, no round
    const after = await billNow(loser.id);
    expect(after).toMatchObject({ status: 'draft', number: null, approval: { rounds: [] } });
    const again = await act('submit', after);
    expect(problemOf(again).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'lines.0.receiptLineId': ['bill_receipt_line_billed'],
    });
    const next = await billed(
      billForm(landlord, [], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'HKP-11/2026',
        expenses: [expense('5220', 'Factory rent, November 2026', '1000')],
        submit: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(next.number).toBe('BILL-2026-27-0008');
    // Settings back as they were, for the tests after this one
    const restored = await send('PUT', '/purchase-accounts', {
      priceDifference: accountId('5180'),
      services: accountId('5170'),
    });
    expect(restored.statusCode, restored.body).toBe(200);
  });
});
```

- **Two clerks type the same delivery note** as two drafts, which is allowed: drafts hold nothing. Submitted at the
  same moment, the first posting locks the receipt line; the second waits, then reads it billed and is
  `bill_receipt_line_billed`. It rolled back whole: still a draft, no number, no round, and the next bill takes the
  next number (0008). Submitted again, it is refused under its line.
- **With no price difference account chosen,** the winner's ৳1,000 over the order goes to 5110 Cost of goods sold
  (decision 17). The test puts Settings back as it was.

### A posted bill

```ts
describe('a posted bill', () => {
  it('is final: not changed, deleted, cancelled or reversed', async () => {
    const edit = await send('PUT', `/bills/${bill1.id}`, formOf(bill1), shirin);
    expect(problemOf(edit).code).toBe('purchase_not_draft');
    const remove = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/bills/${bill1.id}?version=${String(bill1.version)}`,
      undefined,
      shirin,
    );
    expect(problemOf(remove).code).toBe('purchase_not_draft');
    expect(problemOf(await act('cancel', bill1)).code).toBe('purchase_cannot_cancel');
    expect(problemOf(await act('reopen', bill1)).code).toBe('purchase_cannot_reopen');
    const entry = journalEntrySchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${bill1.entry?.id ?? ''}`)).json(),
    );
    const reversed = await send('POST', `/journal-entries/${entry.id}/reverse`, {
      version: entry.version,
      date: '2026-10-17',
    });
    expect(problemOf(reversed).code).toBe('journal_is_purchase');
  });

  it('keeps its supplier, its products and its accounts', async () => {
    const supplier = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/suppliers/${threadShop.id}?version=${String(threadShop.version)}`,
    );
    expect(problemOf(supplier).code).toBe('supplier_in_use');
    const product = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/products/${servicing.id}?version=${String(servicing.version)}`,
    );
    expect(problemOf(product).code).toBe('product_in_use');
    // An account a draft's expense names, with no entry yet
    const made = await send('POST', '/accounts', {
      parentId: accountId('5200'),
      code: '5295',
      name: 'Factory canteen',
      isGroup: false,
      holdsMoney: false,
      description: '',
    });
    expect(made.statusCode, made.body).toBe(201);
    const canteen = accountSchema.parse(made.json());
    accounts = [...accounts, canteen];
    await billed(
      billForm(landlord, [], {
        supplierBillNumber: 'HKP-C-10',
        expenses: [expense('5295', 'Canteen space, October 2026', '5000')],
      }),
    );
    const account = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/accounts/${canteen.id}?version=${String(canteen.version)}`,
    );
    expect(problemOf(account).code).toBe('account_in_use');
  });

  it('lists by what is still owed, and the books agree', async () => {
    const open = billPageSchema.parse((await send('GET', '/bills?payment=open')).json());
    // Oldest due date first: the order a payment pays them in
    const dues = open.items.map((item) => item.dueDate);
    expect(dues).toEqual(dues.toSorted());
    expect(dues[0]).toBe('2026-10-16');
    expect(open.items.map((item) => item.number).toSorted()).toEqual([
      'BILL-2026-27-0001',
      'BILL-2026-27-0002',
      'BILL-2026-27-0004',
      'BILL-2026-27-0005',
      'BILL-2026-27-0006',
      'BILL-2026-27-0007',
      'BILL-2026-27-0008',
    ]);
    const [row] = await superuserSql(
      (sql) => sql<{ unbilled: string; payable: string; owed: string }[]>`
        WITH t AS (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE slug = 'rupsha-knit')
        SELECT
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(l.credit - l.debit), 0)::text FROM journal_lines l
             JOIN ledger_accounts a ON a.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND a.id = l.account_id
            WHERE a.code = '2115' AND a.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM t)) AS unbilled,
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(l.credit - l.debit), 0)::text FROM journal_lines l
             JOIN ledger_accounts a ON a.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND a.id = l.account_id
            WHERE a.code = '2110' AND a.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM t)) AS payable,
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(total - amount_paid), 0)::text FROM bills
            WHERE status = 'posted' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM t)) AS owed`,
    );
    // Every receipt is billed, so goods received not billed is back to zero; the payable is
    // what the posted bills still owe
    expect(row?.unbilled).toBe('0.0000');
    expect(row?.payable).toBe(row?.owed);
  });
});
```

- **It is final:** not changed, deleted, cancelled or reopened, and its entry is out of the journal's Reverse
  (`journal_is_purchase`, decision 26). A debit note corrects it (17d).
- **It keeps what it names:** the thread shop (`supplier_in_use`), the generator servicing it billed
  (`product_in_use`), and an expense account a draft bill names (`account_in_use`, from the bill expenses' foreign
  key; the account has no entry yet, so nothing else could keep it).
- **The open list is oldest due date first**, the order a payment pays them in.
- **The books agree:** every receipt is billed, so 2115 is back to ৳0, and the payable equals what the posted bills
  still owe, read straight from the tables.

```ts
// Step 17c: a denim factory pays its yarn supplier. Three bills are open, the oldest overdue; a
// cheque pays the oldest first, an advance is paid against an order before its bill comes, a cheque
// bounces. Payments from ৳50,000 need the finance manager. Each test builds on the ones before it:
// read the first failure first.
let pg: TestPostgres;
let redis: TestRedis;
let app: NestFastifyApplication;
let worker: INestApplicationContext;
// Farhana, the Owner: books the bills (approved and posted the moment she submits them)
let owner: SignedIn;
// Rina, the cashier: writes the payments (purchase.payment.manage)
let rina: SignedIn;
// Kamal, the finance manager: the one level of the payments' approval
let kamal: SignedIn;
// Mitu, a merchandiser: writes orders, never pays
let mitu: SignedIn;
let financeManager: Role;
let units: Unit[];
let rates: TaxRate[];
let accounts: Account[];
let main: Warehouse;
// The yarn supplier, with a bank account a payment can name
let yarn: Supplier;
let trims: Supplier;
let dyeing: Product;
// An approved order for the yarn dyeing: the advance is paid against it
let orderY: PurchaseOrder;
// The yarn supplier's bills: due 15 Oct (overdue), 4 Nov and 9 Nov
let billA: Bill;
let billB: Bill;
let billC: Bill;
// The trims supplier's bill: never on a payment to the yarn supplier
let billK: Bill;
// The cheque that pays A and part of B, and bounces
let cheque: SupplierPayment;
// A transfer for bill A, written while A still owed everything and submitted after the cheque
let late: SupplierPayment;
// The advance against order Y
let advance: SupplierPayment;

function send(
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE',
  url: string,
  payload?: object,
  as = owner,
) {
  return app.inject({
    method,
    url,
    headers: bearer(as.accessToken),
    ...(payload && { payload }),
  });
}

function problemOf(res: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof send>>) {
  return problemSchema.parse(res.json());
}

function unitId(code: string): string {
  const found = units.find((unit) => unit.code === code);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no unit ${code}`);
  return found.id;
}

function rateId(name: string): string {
  const found = rates.find((rate) => rate.name === name);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no VAT rate ${name}`);
  return found.id;
}

function accountId(code: string): string {
  const found = accounts.find((item) => item.code === code);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no account ${code}`);
  return found.id;
}

function codeOf(id: string): string {
  const found = accounts.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no account ${id}`);
  return found.code;
}

function bankAccountOf(supplier: Supplier): string {
  const [account] = supplier.bankAccounts;
  if (!account) throw new Error(`${supplier.name} has no bank account`);
  return account.id;
}

const yarnBank = {

};

async function member(

// A bill of one expense, booked by the Owner, posted at once
async function postedBill(
  supplier: Supplier,
  supplierBillNumber: string,
  date: string,
  dueDate: string,

  extra: Partial<BillFormValues> = {},
): Promise<Bill> {

    dueDate,
    supplierBillNumber,

    mushakDate: '',

    warehouseId: '',
    pricesIncludeVat: false,
    note: '',
    lines: [],
    expenses: [
      {
        accountId: accountId('5140'),
        description: 'Yarn dyeing, indigo',
        amount,
        taxRateId: rateId('VAT 15%'),
      },
    ],
    submit: true,
    ...extra,
  } satisfies Omit<BillFormValues, 'version'>);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);
  const bill = billSchema.parse(res.json());
  expect(bill.status).toBe('posted');
  return bill;
}

async function billNow(id: string): Promise<Bill> {
  const res = await send('GET', `/bills/${id}`);

}

// What a bill has been paid, and what it still owes
async function paidOf(bill: Bill) {
  const now = await billNow(bill.id);
  return [now.amountPaid, now.payments.map((item) => [item.paymentNumber, item.amount])];
}

async function openBills(supplier: Supplier, filter: 'open' | 'overdue' | 'paid' = 'open') {
  const page = billPageSchema.parse(
    (await send('GET', `/bills?payment=${filter}&supplierId=${supplier.id}`)).json(),

    supplierBankAccountId: '',
    branchId: main.branchId,
    orderId: '',
    note: '',
    allocations: allocations.map((item) => ({ billId: item.bill.id, amount: item.amount })),

async function paid(body: object, as = rina): Promise<SupplierPayment> {
  const res = await send('POST', '/supplier-payments', body, as);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(201);

}

async function paymentNow(id: string): Promise<SupplierPayment> {
  const res = await send('GET', `/supplier-payments/${id}`);
  expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
  return supplierPaymentSchema.parse(res.json());
}

function act(action: 'submit' | 'reopen' | 'cancel', payment: SupplierPayment, as = rina) {
  return send(
    'POST',
    `/supplier-payments/${payment.id}/${action}`,
    { version: payment.version },

  );

async function acted(action: 'submit' | 'reopen' | 'cancel', payment: SupplierPayment) {

function allocate(payment: SupplierPayment, allocations: { bill: Bill; amount: string }[]) {
  return send(
    'PUT',
    `/supplier-payments/${payment.id}/allocations`,
    {
      version: payment.version,
      allocations: allocations.map((item) => ({ billId: item.bill.id, amount: item.amount })),
    },

}

async function entryLines(id: string | undefined) {
  const entry = journalEntrySchema.parse(
    (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${id ?? 'none'}`)).json(),
  );
  return entry.lines.map((item) => [
    codeOf(item.accountId),
    item.debit,
    item.credit,
    item.party?.name ?? null,
  ]);
}

async function entryCount(): Promise<number> {
  const page = journalPageSchema.parse((await send('GET', '/journal-entries?limit=100')).json());
  return page.items.length;
}

async function superuserSql<T>(fn: (sql: postgres.Sql) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const sql = postgres(pg.superuserUrl, { max: 1, onnotice: () => undefined });
  try {
    return await fn(sql);
  } finally {
    await sql.end();
  }
}
```

- **A second workspace of its own** (Jamuna Denim), so the bill and payment numbers here start at 0001, and the
  payment rule (from ৳50,000) is set where the payment tests need it.
- **Rina, the cashier, writes the payments; Kamal approves the large ones; Mitu, a merchandiser, never pays:** the
  403 test.
- **A bank account (1121) under 1120,** for the cheques and transfers, as an accountant adds one.
- **The yarn supplier has a bank account,** which a payment can name (decision 24); the trims supplier has one too,
  which A's payment to the yarn supplier must not take.
- **Order Y,** approved, for yarn dyeing: the advance is paid against it, and its bill comes later.
- **Four bills, posted by the Owner:** ৳46,000 due on 15 Oct (overdue), ৳23,000 and ৳11,500 due in November, and the
  trims supplier's ৳5,750. `postedBill()` books one expense, so a bill takes one line of setup.

### Writing a payment

```ts
describe('supplier payments', () => {
  it('start from the open bills, oldest due date first', async () => {
    expect([billA.number, billA.total, billB.total, billC.total]).toEqual([
      'BILL-2026-27-0001',
      '46000.0000',
      '23000.0000',
      '11500.0000',
    ]);
    expect(await openBills(yarn)).toEqual(['PYT-0931', 'PYT-0957', 'PYT-0978']);
    // Overdue in the workspace's time zone: the day after its due date
    expect(await openBills(yarn, 'overdue')).toEqual(['PYT-0931']);
    expect(await openBills(yarn, 'paid')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keep a draft's allocations as a plan, which no bill counts", async () => {
    cheque = await paid(
      paymentForm(
        '60000',
        [
          { bill: billA, amount: '46000' },
          { bill: billB, amount: '14000' },
        ],
        { supplierBankAccountId: bankAccountOf(yarn) },
      ),
    );
    expect(cheque).toMatchObject({
      number: null,
      status: 'draft',
      amount: '60000.0000',
      // The plan counts on the payment itself: "never more than the payment"
      applied: '60000.0000',
      method: 'cheque',
      reference: 'DBBL CHQ 004512',
      supplierBankAccount: { bankName: 'Dutch-Bangla Bank', accountNumber: '1051100045672' },
      entry: null,
    });
    expect(cheque.allocations.map((item) => [item.billNumber, item.amount])).toEqual([
      ['BILL-2026-27-0001', '46000.0000'],
      ['BILL-2026-27-0002', '14000.0000'],
    ]);
    // ...but not on the bills: nothing is paid until it is posted
    expect(await paidOf(billA)).toEqual(['0.0000', []]);
    expect(await openBills(yarn, 'overdue')).toEqual(['PYT-0931']);
    // So a second draft may plan the same money: it holds nothing either
    late = await paid(
      paymentForm('20000', [{ bill: billA, amount: '20000' }], { method: 'bank_transfer' }),
    );
    expect(late.allocations.map((item) => item.amount)).toEqual(['20000.0000']);
  });

  it('refuse what the contract sees, then what only the server knows, each under its box', async () => {
    const over = await send(
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm('10000', [
        { bill: billA, amount: '6000' },
        { bill: billA, amount: '6000' },
      ]),
      rina,
    );
    expect(over.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(problemOf(over).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.1.billId': ['payment_bill_twice'],
      allocations: ['payment_over_allocated'],
    });
    // Another supplier's bill, and more than a bill still owes
    const bills = await send(
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm('40000', [
        { bill: billK, amount: '5750' },
        { bill: billB, amount: '25000' },
      ]),
      rina,
    );
    expect(bills.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(bills).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.0.billId': ['payment_bill_invalid'],
      'allocations.1.amount': ['payment_over_bill'],
    });
    // Money leaves a cash, bank or wallet account; to one of this supplier's own bank accounts;
    // against an order of this supplier
    const account = await send(
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm('1000', [], { accountId: accountId('5140') }),
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(account).fieldErrors).toEqual({ accountId: ['payment_account_invalid'] });
    const theirBank = await send(
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm('1000', [], { supplierBankAccountId: bankAccountOf(trims) }),
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(theirBank).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      supplierBankAccountId: ['payment_bank_account_invalid'],
    });
    const theirOrder = await send(
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm('1000', [], { supplierId: trims.id, orderId: orderY.id }),
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(theirOrder).fieldErrors).toEqual({ orderId: ['payment_order_invalid'] });
    // The merchandiser agreed the price; paying is the cashier's job
    const notHers = await send('POST', '/supplier-payments', paymentForm('1000', []), mitu);
    expect(notHers.statusCode).toBe(403);
  });
});
```

- **The open bills come oldest due date first**, and the overdue one is overdue by the workspace's day.
- **A draft's allocations are a plan** (decisions 23 and 32): the cheque of ৳60,000 plans ৳46,000 on the first bill
  and ৳14,000 on the second. `applied` counts the plan (never more than the payment), the bills count nothing, and a
  second draft may plan the same money.
- **The contract's rules come first:** the same bill twice, more applied than paid. **Then the server's:** another
  supplier's bill, more than a bill still owes, an account that holds no money, another supplier's bank account,
  an order of another supplier.

### Approval and posting

```ts
describe('approval and posting', () => {
  it('waits for the finance manager from ৳50,000, and posting applies the plan', async () => {
    const rule = await send('PUT', '/approval-rules/supplier_payment', {
      levels: [{ minAmount: '50000', roleId: financeManager.id }],
      version: 0,
    });
    expect(rule.statusCode, rule.body).toBe(200);
    cheque = await acted('submit', cheque);
    expect(cheque).toMatchObject({ number: 'PV-2026-27-0001', status: 'pending' });
    expect(cheque.approval.rounds[0]).toMatchObject({
      status: 'pending',
      amount: '60000.0000',
      submittedBy: { name: 'Rina Begum' },
    });
    // Still a plan while it waits
    expect(await paidOf(billA)).toEqual(['0.0000', []]);
    const [round] = cheque.approval.rounds;
    const approved = await send(
      'POST',
      `/approvals/supplier_payment/${cheque.id}/approve`,
      { roundId: round?.id ?? '', comment: '' },
      kamal,
    );
    expect(approved.statusCode, approved.body).toBe(204);
    cheque = await paymentNow(cheque.id);
    expect(cheque).toMatchObject({ status: 'posted', applied: '60000.0000' });
    expect(await entryLines(cheque.entry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['2110', '60000.0000', '0.0000', 'Padma Yarn Traders'],
      ['1121', '0.0000', '60000.0000', null],
    ]);
    expect(await paidOf(billA)).toEqual(['46000.0000', [['PV-2026-27-0001', '46000.0000']]]);
    expect(await paidOf(billB)).toEqual(['14000.0000', [['PV-2026-27-0001', '14000.0000']]]);
    expect(await openBills(yarn)).toEqual(['PYT-0957', 'PYT-0978']);
    expect(await openBills(yarn, 'paid')).toEqual(['PYT-0931']);
  });

  it('check the plan again when submitted: a bill paid since does not take it', async () => {
    // Written while A still owed everything, submitted after the cheque paid it. Saved now, the
    // same plan would be refused at once.
    const refused = await act('submit', late);
    expect(refused.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(problemOf(refused).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.0.amount': ['payment_over_bill'],
    });
    const still = await paymentNow(late.id);
    expect(still).toMatchObject({ status: 'draft', number: null, approval: { rounds: [] } });
    // Deleted, it was never numbered
    const removed = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/supplier-payments/${late.id}?version=${String(still.version)}`,
      undefined,
      rina,
    );
    expect(removed.statusCode).toBe(204);
  });
});
```

- **From ৳50,000 the finance manager approves**, and the plan stays a plan while it waits. Approved, the payment is
  posted: Dr 2110 with the supplier, Cr 1121, and the plan lands on the bills. The first bill is paid and leaves the
  open list.
- **The plan is checked again when submitted:** the second draft planned ৳20,000 on the first bill, which is paid
  now, so its submit is `payment_over_bill` under its row, and it stays an unnumbered draft. (Saved now, the same
  plan would be refused at once.)

### Advances

```ts
describe('advances', () => {
  it('are what a payment does not apply, and may name the order they were paid against', async () => {
    // A cash advance with no order, older, then ৳30,000 by transfer against order Y. Below
    // ৳50,000, so each posts the moment it is submitted.
    const cash = await paid(
      paymentForm('5000', [], {
        date: '2026-10-08',
        accountId: accountId('1110'),
        method: 'cash',
        reference: '',
        submit: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(cash).toMatchObject({ number: 'PV-2026-27-0002', status: 'posted', applied: '0.0000' });
    advance = await paid(
      paymentForm('30000', [], {
        method: 'bank_transfer',
        reference: 'BEFTN 26101700451',
        supplierBankAccountId: bankAccountOf(yarn),
        orderId: orderY.id,
        submit: true,
      }),
    );
    expect(advance).toMatchObject({
      number: 'PV-2026-27-0003',
      status: 'posted',
      order: { id: orderY.id, number: orderY.number },
    });
    const order = purchaseOrderSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/purchase-orders/${orderY.id}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(order.advances).toMatchObject([
      { number: 'PV-2026-27-0003', amount: '30000.0000', applied: '0.0000' },
    ]);
    const byOrder = supplierPaymentPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/supplier-payments?orderId=${orderY.id}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(byOrder.items.map((item) => item.number)).toEqual(['PV-2026-27-0003']);
  });

  it('are offered first on the bill of their order, and applied later with no entry', async () => {
    // The dyeing house's bill for order Y: ৳23,000
    const lineY = orderY.lines[0];
    if (!lineY) throw new Error('order Y has no line');
    const billY = await postedBill(yarn, 'PYT-1004', '2026-10-17', '', '0', {
      expenses: [],
      lines: [
        {
          variantId: lineY.variantId,
          unitId: lineY.unitId,
          quantity: lineY.quantity,
          description: '',
          unitPrice: lineY.unitPrice,
          discountType: 'percent',
          discount: '',
          taxRateId: lineY.taxRate.id,
          receiptLineId: '',
          orderLineId: lineY.id,
          accountId: '',
          lotNumber: '',
          expiresOn: '',
          manufacturedOn: '',
          serialNumbers: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    // The order's advance first, though the cash one is older
    expect(billY.advances.map((item) => [item.paymentNumber, item.unapplied])).toEqual([
      ['PV-2026-27-0003', '30000.0000'],
      ['PV-2026-27-0002', '5000.0000'],
    ]);
    const entries = await entryCount();
    // Too much for the payment, and too much for a bill
    const tooMuch = await allocate(advance, [
      { bill: billY, amount: '23000' },
      { bill: billC, amount: '11500' },
    ]);
    expect(problemOf(tooMuch).code).toBe('payment_over_allocated');
    const overBill = await allocate(advance, [{ bill: billC, amount: '12000' }]);
    expect(problemOf(overBill).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.0.amount': ['payment_over_bill'],
    });
    const res = await allocate(advance, [{ bill: billY, amount: '23000' }]);
    expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
    advance = supplierPaymentSchema.parse(res.json());
    expect(advance.applied).toBe('23000.0000');
    expect(await paidOf(billY)).toEqual(['23000.0000', [['PV-2026-27-0003', '23000.0000']]]);
    // Only which bill the money settles changed: the books did not
    expect(await entryCount()).toBe(entries);
    const audit = auditPageSchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/audit-logs?entityType=supplier_payment&entityId=${advance.id}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(audit.items[0]?.action).toBe('supplier_payment.allocated');
    // A draft is changed with its form, not applied
    const draft = await paid(paymentForm('1000', []));
    expect(problemOf(await allocate(draft, [])).code).toBe('payment_not_posted');
  });
});
```

- **Money not applied is an advance** (decisions 5 and 12): ৳5,000 in cash with no order, and ৳30,000 by transfer
  against order Y, each below the level, so posted when submitted. The order shows its advance, and the payment list
  filters by order.
- **The order's advance is offered first** on that order's bill, ahead of the older cash one.
- **Applied later, with no new entry:** ৳23,000 of the transfer goes to the bill. More than the payment
  (`payment_over_allocated`) or more than a bill owes (`payment_over_bill`) is refused. The journal has no new entry,
  because the payable is one number per supplier; the audit log has `supplier_payment.allocated`. A draft is changed
  with its form (`payment_not_posted`).

### A posted payment

```ts
describe('a posted payment', () => {
  it('is voided, not changed: its money comes off the bills and its entry is reversed', async () => {
    const edit = await send(
      'PUT',
      `/supplier-payments/${cheque.id}`,
      { ...paymentForm('60000', []), version: cheque.version },
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(edit).code).toBe('purchase_not_draft');
    expect(problemOf(await act('cancel', cheque)).code).toBe('purchase_cannot_cancel');
    const entry = journalEntrySchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${cheque.entry?.id ?? ''}`)).json(),
    );
    const reversed = await send('POST', `/journal-entries/${entry.id}/reverse`, {
      version: entry.version,
      date: '2026-10-18',
    });
    expect(problemOf(reversed).code).toBe('journal_is_purchase');

    const early = await send(
      'POST',
      `/supplier-payments/${cheque.id}/void`,
      { version: cheque.version, date: '2026-10-15', reason: 'Cheque bounced' },
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(early).fieldErrors).toEqual({ date: ['payment_void_date'] });
    const res = await send(
      'POST',
      `/supplier-payments/${cheque.id}/void`,
      { version: cheque.version, date: '2026-10-18', reason: 'Cheque bounced: insufficient funds' },
      rina,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
    cheque = supplierPaymentSchema.parse(res.json());
    expect(cheque).toMatchObject({
      status: 'voided',
      number: 'PV-2026-27-0001',
      applied: '0.0000',
      allocations: [],
      voidDate: '2026-10-18',
      voidReason: 'Cheque bounced: insufficient funds',
    });
    expect(await entryLines(cheque.voidEntry?.id)).toEqual([
      ['2110', '0.0000', '60000.0000', 'Padma Yarn Traders'],
      ['1121', '60000.0000', '0.0000', null],
    ]);
    const reversal = journalEntrySchema.parse(
      (await send('GET', `/journal-entries/${cheque.voidEntry?.id ?? ''}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(reversal).toMatchObject({ date: '2026-10-18', source: 'reversal' });
    // A is owed again, and overdue; the voided payment is not among what it was paid
    expect(await paidOf(billA)).toEqual(['0.0000', []]);
    expect(await paidOf(billB)).toEqual(['0.0000', []]);
    expect(await openBills(yarn, 'overdue')).toEqual(['PYT-0931']);
    const again = await send(
      'POST',
      `/supplier-payments/${cheque.id}/void`,
      { version: cheque.version, date: '2026-10-18', reason: 'Again' },
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(again).code).toBe('payment_not_posted');
  });

  it("forgets the supplier's bank account when the supplier's form removes it", async () => {
    const current = supplierSchema.parse((await send('GET', `/suppliers/${yarn.id}`)).json());
    const res = await send('PUT', `/suppliers/${yarn.id}`, {
      ...supplierForm('Padma Yarn Traders', []),
      code: current.code,
      version: current.version,
    });
    expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
    yarn = supplierSchema.parse(res.json());
    // Voided and posted alike: only the link goes
    expect((await paymentNow(cheque.id)).supplierBankAccount).toBeNull();
    expect((await paymentNow(advance.id)).supplierBankAccount).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- **It is not changed, cancelled or reversed in the journal.** It is voided: not before the day it was paid
  (`payment_void_date`), and with a reason. The money comes off both bills (the first is overdue again), the entry
  is reversed on the void date (source `reversal`), and a voided payment is not voided again.
- **The supplier's bank account goes from it** when the supplier's form removes the account (decision 33), on a
  voided payment and a posted one alike.

### Reopen and cancel

```ts
describe('reopen and cancel', () => {
  it('take a waiting payment back, and a cancelled one keeps its plan as history', async () => {
    let big = await paid(
      paymentForm(
        '57500',
        [
          { bill: billA, amount: '46000' },
          { bill: billC, amount: '11500' },
        ],
        { submit: true },
      ),
    );
    expect(big).toMatchObject({ number: 'PV-2026-27-0004', status: 'pending' });
    big = await acted('reopen', big);
    expect(big.status).toBe('draft');
    expect(big.approval.rounds[0]?.status).toBe('reopened');
    const remove = await send(
      'DELETE',
      `/supplier-payments/${big.id}?version=${String(big.version)}`,
      undefined,
      rina,
    );
    expect(problemOf(remove).code).toBe('purchase_was_submitted');
    big = await acted('submit', big);
    big = await acted('cancel', big);
    expect(big).toMatchObject({ status: 'cancelled', number: 'PV-2026-27-0004' });
    expect(big.approval.rounds[0]?.status).toBe('reopened');
    expect(big.allocations.map((item) => item.billNumber)).toEqual([
      'BILL-2026-27-0001',
      'BILL-2026-27-0003',
    ]);
    expect(await paidOf(billC)).toEqual(['0.0000', []]);
    // A draft nobody submitted is deleted instead
    const draft = await paid(paymentForm('1000', []));
    expect(problemOf(await act('cancel', draft)).code).toBe('purchase_delete_instead');
  });
});
```

- **A waiting payment is taken back** (its round ends as "reopened"), not deleted once numbered, and cancelled while
  waiting by reopening it first. A cancelled payment keeps its plan as history, and the bills count none of it. A
  draft nobody submitted is deleted.

### Two payments at the same moment, and the books

```ts
describe('two payments at the same moment', () => {
  it("pay a bill's last money once: the second waits, then finds it paid", async () => {
    // Two cashiers each pay the overdue bill in full, by transfer (below ৳50,000: posted at once)
    const [a, b] = await Promise.all(
      ['BEFTN 26101800101', 'BEFTN 26101800102'].map((reference) =>
        paid(
          paymentForm('46000', [{ bill: billA, amount: '46000' }], {
            method: 'bank_transfer',
            reference,
          }),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (!a || !b) throw new Error('two drafts expected');
    const [first, second] = await Promise.all([act('submit', a), act('submit', b)]);
    const codes = [first, second].map((res) =>
      res.statusCode === 200 ? 'posted' : problemOf(res).code,
    );
    expect(codes.toSorted()).toEqual(['payment_over_bill', 'posted']);
    const loser = first.statusCode === 200 ? b : a;
    expect(await paymentNow(loser.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'draft', number: null });
    const [amountPaid] = await paidOf(billA);
    expect(amountPaid).toBe('46000.0000');
    expect(await openBills(yarn, 'overdue')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keep the payable equal to what the bills owe less the advances', async () => {
    const [row] = await superuserSql(
      (sql) => sql<{ payable: string; owed: string; ahead: string }[]>`
        WITH t AS (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE slug = 'jamuna-denim')
        SELECT
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(l.credit - l.debit), 0)::text FROM journal_lines l
             JOIN ledger_accounts a ON a.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND a.id = l.account_id
            WHERE a.code = '2110' AND a.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM t)
              AND l.party_id = ${yarn.id}) AS payable,
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(total - amount_paid), 0)::text FROM bills
            WHERE status = 'posted' AND supplier_id = ${yarn.id}) AS owed,
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount - applied), 0)::text FROM supplier_payments
            WHERE status = 'posted' AND supplier_id = ${yarn.id}) AS ahead`,
    );
    // Owed: B ৳23,000 and C ৳11,500 (A paid, Y paid). Ahead: the cash ৳5,000 and ৳7,000 left of
    // the transfer. The payable is ৳34,500 − ৳12,000.
    expect(row).toEqual({ payable: '22500.0000', owed: '34500.0000', ahead: '12000.0000' });
  });
});
```

- **Two transfers for the overdue bill's ৳46,000**, each a draft that fits. Submitted at the same moment, the first
  locks the bill; the second waits, then finds it paid: `payment_over_bill`, still an unnumbered draft. The bill is
  paid once.
- **The payable is what the bills owe less the advances:** ৳34,500 owed, ৳12,000 paid ahead (the cash ৳5,000 and
  ৳7,000 left of the transfer), ৳22,500 in 2110 for the supplier. The cheque that bounced counts for nothing.

```ts
function as(

  url: string,

) {

function pcsOf(units: Unit[]): string {
  const pcs = units.find((unit) => unit.code === 'pcs');
  if (!pcs) throw new Error('no pcs');
  return pcs.id;
}

function vatOf(rates: TaxRate[]): string {
  const found = rates.find((rate) => rate.name === 'VAT 15%');
  if (!found) throw new Error('no VAT 15%');
  return found.id;
}

function codeIn(accounts: Account[], code: string): string {
  const found = accounts.find((item) => item.code === code);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no account ${code}`);
  return found.id;
}

function variantOf(product: Product): string {
  const [variant] = product.variants;
  if (!variant) throw new Error(`${product.name} has no variant`);
  return variant.id;
}

describe("another workspace's bills", () => {
  it('are not read, changed, deleted, submitted, reopened or cancelled', async () => {
    for (const bill of [billOfB, pendingBillOfB]) {
      const version = { version: bill.version };
      const answers = await Promise.all([
        as(tenantA, 'GET', `/bills/${bill.id}`),
        as(tenantA, 'PUT', `/bills/${bill.id}`, {
          ...billForm(supplierOfA.id, warehouseOfA, {
            expenses: [expenseOf(accountsOfA, ratesOfA)],
          }),
          version: bill.version,
        }),
        as(tenantA, 'DELETE', `/bills/${bill.id}?version=${String(bill.version)}`),
        as(tenantA, 'POST', `/bills/${bill.id}/submit`, version),
        as(tenantA, 'POST', `/bills/${bill.id}/reopen`, version),
        as(tenantA, 'POST', `/bills/${bill.id}/cancel`, version),
      ]);
      expect(answers.map((res) => res.statusCode)).toEqual([404, 404, 404, 404, 404, 404]);
      const after = await billOfBNow(bill.id);
      expect([after.status, after.version]).toEqual([bill.status, bill.version]);
    }
    const page = billPageSchema.parse(
      (await as(tenantA, 'GET', `/bills?supplierId=${supplierOfB.id}`)).json(),
    );
    expect(page.items).toEqual([]);
    const all = billPageSchema.parse((await as(tenantA, 'GET', '/bills?payment=open')).json());
    expect(all.items).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("are not approved from A, nor in A's waiting list", async () => {
    const [round] = pendingBillOfB.approval.rounds;
    const res = await as(tenantA, 'POST', `/approvals/bill/${pendingBillOfB.id}/approve`, {

      (await as(tenantA, 'GET', '/approvals/waiting')).json(),
    );
    expect(waiting.items).toEqual([]);
    expect((await billOfBNow(pendingBillOfB.id)).status).toBe('pending');
  });
});

        }),
      ]);
      expect(answers.map((res) => res.statusCode)).toEqual([404, 404, 404, 404, 404, 404]);
      const after = await paymentOfBNow(payment.id);
      expect([after.status, after.version, after.applied]).toEqual([
        payment.status,
        payment.version,
        payment.applied,
      ]);
    }
    const page = supplierPaymentPageSchema.parse(
      (await as(tenantA, 'GET', '/supplier-payments')).json(),
    );
    expect(page.items).toEqual([]);
    // B's bill was paid only by B's payment
    expect((await billOfBNow(billOfB.id)).amountPaid).toBe('1000.0000');
  });

  it("are not where A's payment goes: B's bills, money, supplier's bank or orders", async () => {
    const bill = await as(
      tenantA,
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm(supplierOfA.id, warehouseOfA, accountsOfA, {
        allocations: [{ billId: billOfB.id, amount: '1000' }],
      }),
    );
    expect(problemOf(bill).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      'allocations.0.billId': ['payment_bill_invalid'],
    });
    const money = await as(
      tenantA,
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm(supplierOfA.id, warehouseOfA, accountsOfB),
    );
    expect(problemOf(money).fieldErrors).toEqual({ accountId: ['payment_account_invalid'] });
    const bank = await as(
      tenantA,
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm(supplierOfA.id, warehouseOfA, accountsOfA, {
        supplierBankAccountId: supplierOfB.bankAccounts[0]?.id ?? '',
      }),
    );
    expect(problemOf(bank).fieldErrors).toEqual({
      supplierBankAccountId: ['payment_bank_account_invalid'],
    });
    const order = await as(
      tenantA,
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm(supplierOfA.id, warehouseOfA, accountsOfA, { orderId: orderOfB.id }),
    );
    expect(problemOf(order).fieldErrors).toEqual({ orderId: ['payment_order_invalid'] });
    const supplier = await as(
      tenantA,
      'POST',
      '/supplier-payments',
      paymentForm(supplierOfB.id, warehouseOfA, accountsOfA),
    );
    expect(problemOf(supplier).fieldErrors).toEqual({ supplierId: ['purchase_supplier_invalid'] });
  });
});
```

- **B has one of everything:** an approved order with goods (received) and a service (not billed), a posted bill
  of the receipt line, a bill waiting for B's Owner (B's accountant wrote it, and a writer never approves their own), a posted
  payment of ৳1,000 on the bill, and a draft payment.
- **B's bills and payments:** every route is 404, and each document has the same status, version and `applied`
  afterwards. A's lists have none of them, whatever the filter names. Approving B's waiting bill from A is 404, and
  A's waiting list is empty.
- **Nothing of B's on A's bill:** B's receipt line and order line, supplier, branch, store, VAT rate and account
  each come back as the same error as an id that does not exist. A's "to bill" lists are empty, and A's Settings →
  Purchase takes none of B's accounts.
- **Nothing of B's on A's payment:** B's bill, B's cash account, B's supplier's bank account, B's order and B's
  supplier. B's bill was paid only by B's payment.

- **The number series list has 20 types now:** 17c.1 added `purchase.payment` (PV). The test checks both new
  purchase series by name, numbered by fiscal year, so a renamed prefix fails here and not on a printed voucher.

### Check this part

```bash
pnpm --filter @omnivo/api typecheck
pnpm lint
cd apps/api
npx vitest run src/purchase --maxWorkers=3
pnpm test:integration
pnpm test:tenant-leak
```

The three new files pass: 19 tests for bills, 12 for supplier payments and 6 for tenant leaks. The whole integration
suite has 458 tests in 33 files and the tenant-leak suite 90 in 17, every one passing. The unit tests still pass
(107).

> **What we checked.** Besides the runs above, we broke four rules on purpose, one at a time, and the tests meant
> for them failed: a receipt line billed already not refused when a bill is saved, "goods received not billed"
> booked with the bill's branch instead of the receipt's, a payment's plan not checked again when it is submitted,
> and an order's own advance not offered first on that order's bill. The first run found the two 17c.3 problems
> described at the top of this part, and the number series test of an earlier step.

---

## 17c.5 — `packages/i18n`: the words

The screens of 17c.6 need their words in English and Bangla, and the app cannot type-check without them, so they
come first. This part changes only the two locale files. The ui package needs nothing new: the bill form is built
from the sales line editor and the totals block (decision 15), its own goods from the stock line words, the payment
form from the money receipt's allocation table, and the approval card and dialogs exist already.

When this part starts, `packages/i18n` has one error: the `errors` object is missing the 35 new codes of 17c.1 and
17c.3. When it ends, the i18n package compiles. The app still has 13 type errors, and none of them is about a
missing word: they are the contract changes the screens and the mock server do not know yet (a goods receipt's
`order` may be null, a receipt line's `billed`, a purchase order's `bills` and `advances`, the approval rules of
the two new kinds). 17c.6 fixes the screens, 17c.7 the mocks.
