"To bill" and "Billed" sit with the statuses, like the orders' "To receive". `isBillFilter` is a type guard, so the
one `show` value splits into the contract's two query fields without a cast. A posted receipt's status cell shows its
billing pill too.

### The bill's lines: `components/bill-lines.tsx` and `bill-pickers.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import {
  Alert02Icon,
  Calendar03Icon,
  PackageReceiveIcon,
  Wrench01Icon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  type Account,
  type BillLineFormValues,
  draftLineAmounts,
  isZeroMoney,
  MAX_BILL_LINES,
  priceDifferenceOf,
  subtractMoney,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Dialog, Input, Select } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { lazy, type ReactNode, Suspense, useState } from 'react';
import type { FieldErrors } from 'react-hook-form';

import type { BillSourcedLine } from '../lib/bill-sources';
import { type BillLineOrigin, billSourceIdOf, ownBillLine } from '../lib/bills';
import { taxRatesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { isServiceLine, type LineMeta, type SalesItem } from '../lib/sales';
import { firstMessage } from '../lib/stock';
import { usePurchasePricing } from './purchase-pricing';
import { LinesEditor, SalesField } from './sales-line-editor';
import { SerialNumbersInput } from './serial-numbers-input';
import { useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The item lines of a supplier bill (step 17c): the sales line editor of the purchase order
// (decision 15), with the invoice's three kinds of line (15c). A goods receipt line and an order's
// service line are billed whole, so their item, unit and quantity are fixed; a line of its own is
// a normal line at the supplier's last price. Under each line, what the line needs beside a sales
// line: the order's price and the difference (decision 8), the expense account of a service
// (decision 16), or the lot of goods the bill receives itself. Its own chunk, loaded by the bill
// form (sales-line-editor.tsx says why the editor is lazy).

// The date boxes of an own goods line bring the popover, like everywhere else; the two pickers are
// a chunk of their own (bill-pickers.tsx says why)
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));
const ReceiptPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./bill-pickers')).ReceiptPicker,
}));
const ServicePicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./bill-pickers')).ServicePicker,
}));

export type BillLinesErrors = FieldErrors<{ lines: BillLineFormValues[] }>['lines'];

type Add = (entries: readonly { line: BillLineFormValues; meta: LineMeta }[]) => boolean;

// Billed whole: a goods receipt line, or an order's service line
function isBilled(line: BillLineFormValues): boolean {
  return billSourceIdOf(line) !== null;
}
```

- **The two pickers are a chunk of their own** (decision 55): with them inside, this editor's chunk was 101 KB, over
  its budget. Most bills are typed with a picker opened once or not at all.
- **`isBilled` fixes a line's item, unit and quantity** when it bills a receipt line or an order's service: both are
  billed whole (decision 4). Its price, discount and VAT rate still change (decision 8).

```tsx
export function BillLinesEditor({
  lines,
  onChange,
  getLines,
  initialMeta,
  supplierId,
  pricesIncludeVat,
  errors,
  origins,
  orderPricing,
  accounts,
  servicesAccount,
  onSourced,
}: {
  lines: BillLineFormValues[];
  onChange: (lines: BillLineFormValues[]) => void;
  getLines: () => BillLineFormValues[];
  initialMeta: LineMeta[];
  supplierId: string;
  pricesIncludeVat: boolean;
  errors: BillLinesErrors;
  origins: ReadonlyMap<string, BillLineOrigin>;
  // How the order lines on the form write their prices (null = no order line yet)
  orderPricing: boolean | null;
  // The accounts a service line may post to (costAccounts), and Settings' "Purchased services"
  // (null = none chosen): what an empty account box stands for
  accounts: readonly Account[];
  servicesAccount: Account | null;
  // Lines a picker added: the form keeps where they came from
  onSourced: (lines: readonly BillSourcedLine[]) => void;
}) {
  const { t, format, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const rates = useQuery(taxRatesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const rateOf = (id: string) => rates?.find((rate) => rate.id === id)?.rate ?? null;
  const pricing = usePurchasePricing(supplierId, pricesIncludeVat, t('bills.noLines'));
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState<'receipts' | 'services' | null>(null);
  const onForm = new Set(lines.flatMap((line) => billSourceIdOf(line) ?? []));
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });

  // A service line's expense account (decision 16): empty = Settings' "Purchased services", named
  // in the empty option so the person sees where it goes. With none chosen there, the empty
  // option says to pick one, the same words the API answers with (bill_account_required).
  const accountBox = (
    index: number,
    value: BillLineFormValues,
    update: (patch: Partial<BillLineFormValues>) => void,
  ) => {
    const id = `lines.${String(index)}.accountId`;
    const error = errors?.[index]?.accountId?.message;
    return (
      <SalesField id={id} label={t('bills.account')} error={error}>
        <Select
          id={id}
          value={value.accountId ?? ''}
          invalid={error !== undefined}
          options={[
            {
              value: '',
              label: servicesAccount
                ? t('bills.accountDefault', {
                    account: `${servicesAccount.code} · ${servicesAccount.name}`,
                  })
                : t('bills.accountPlaceholder'),
            },
            ...accounts.map((account) => ({
              value: account.id,
              label: `${account.code} · ${account.name}`,
            })),
          ]}
          onChange={(event) => {
            update({ accountId: event.target.value });
          }}
        />
        {servicesAccount === null && (value.accountId ?? '') === '' && error === undefined && (
          <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('bills.accountRequired')}</span>
        )}
      </SalesField>
    );
  };

  const note = ({
    value,
    index,
    item,
    update,
  }: {
    value: BillLineFormValues;
    index: number;
    item: SalesItem;
    update: (patch: Partial<BillLineFormValues>) => void;
  }): ReactNode => {
    const lineErrors = errors?.[index];
    const origin = origins.get(billSourceIdOf(value) ?? '');
    // A billed line's own problem: billed by another bill since, not this supplier's, or (a line
    // whose unit and quantity are fixed) not billed whole. The fixed cells have no box to show it
    // under, so it shows here.
    const sourceError =
      lineErrors?.receiptLineId?.message ??
      lineErrors?.orderLineId?.message ??
      lineErrors?.quantity?.message ??
      lineErrors?.unitId?.message;
    if (value.receiptLineId) {
      const amount = draftLineAmounts(value, rateOf(value.taxRateId), pricesIncludeVat);
      const orderValue = origin?.orderValue ?? null;
      const difference =
        amount && orderValue !== null ? priceDifferenceOf({ ...amount, orderValue }) : null;
      return (
        <span className="grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
          <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">
            {t('bills.fromReceipt', { number: origin?.receiptNumber ?? '' })}
            {origin?.orderNumber && ` · ${origin.orderNumber}`}
          </span>
          <span>{t('bills.receiptLineHint')}</span>
          {/* What the goods receipt booked, and how far this price is from it (decision 8). Before
              VAT, like the books: the difference goes to an account at its net. */}
          {orderValue !== null && (
            <span className="tabular-nums">
              {t('bills.orderValue', { amount: money(orderValue) })}
              {difference !== null && !isZeroMoney(difference) && (
                <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">
                  {' · '}
                  {difference.startsWith('-')
                    ? t('bills.underOrder', { amount: money(subtractMoney('0', difference)) })
                    : t('bills.overOrder', { amount: money(difference) })}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          )}
          <SourceError message={sourceError} />
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (value.orderLineId) {
      return (
        <span className="grid gap-2">
          <span className="grid gap-0.5 text-caption">
            <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">
              {t('bills.fromOrder', { number: origin?.orderNumber ?? '' })}
            </span>
            <SourceError message={sourceError} />
          </span>
          {accountBox(index, value, update)}
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (isServiceLine(item)) return accountBox(index, value, update);
    return (
      <OwnGoods
        index={index}
        item={item}
        line={value}
        update={update}
        errors={{
          lotNumber: lineErrors?.lotNumber?.message,
          expiresOn: lineErrors?.expiresOn?.message,
          manufacturedOn: lineErrors?.manufacturedOn?.message,
          serialNumbers: firstMessage(lineErrors?.serialNumbers),
          // bill_account_not_allowed: an account on goods (a product changed to goods since)
          accountId: lineErrors?.accountId?.message,
        }}
      />
    );
  };

  // What both pickers share: add the lines unless they would mix the orders' two ways of writing
  // prices (the API's bill_vat_mixed) or pass the line limit; say why in the dialog otherwise
  const addSourced = (sourced: readonly BillSourcedLine[], setting: boolean | null, add: Add) => {
    if (setting !== null && orderPricing !== null && setting !== orderPricing) {
      return errorText('bill_vat_mixed');
    }
    if (!add(sourced.map(({ line, meta }) => ({ line, meta })))) {
      return t('purchaseLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_BILL_LINES });
    }
    onSourced(sourced);
    return null;
  };
```

- **`usePurchasePricing(…, t('bills.noLines'))`:** a line of its own starts at the supplier's last price, like an
  order's.
- **`accountBox` is a service line's expense account** (decision 49). Its empty option names the Settings account,
  so the person sees where an empty box goes; with none in Settings, the empty option says to pick one and a hint
  under the box says why, in the API's own words (`bills.accountRequired`), before the API refuses.
- **The note under a receipt line** says which receipt and order it is from, that its item, unit and quantity are
  the receipt's, what the receipt booked, and how far this line's price is from it (decision 47). The difference is
  worked out from the line's net with the contract's `priceDifferenceOf`: before VAT, the amount the books post.
- **`sourceError` collects four fields.** A fixed line shows its unit and quantity as text, with no box to show an
  error under, so `bill_receipt_line_quantity` (on `quantity`) and a billed-elsewhere line (`receiptLineId`) both
  show here.
- **An order's service line gets its account box too;** so does a service line of its own. A goods line of its own
  gets `OwnGoods`.
- **`addSourced` refuses before the API does:** a second way of writing prices (`bill_vat_mixed`, in the API's
  words) or more lines than a bill holds. It says why inside the dialog, next to the button that caused it; a toast
  would hide behind the dialog.

```tsx
  return (
    <LinesEditor<BillLineFormValues>
      lines={lines}
      onChange={onChange}
      getLines={getLines}
      initialMeta={initialMeta}
      pricing={pricing}
      pricesIncludeVat={pricesIncludeVat}
      errors={errors}
      newLine={ownBillLine}
      maxLines={MAX_BILL_LINES}
      fixed={isBilled}
      lineNote={note}
      // The bill's totals count its expenses too, so the form shows them under the expenses
      totals={false}
      moreAdds={(add) => (
        <>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            disabled={supplierId === ''}
            onClick={() => {
              setPicking('receipts');
            }}
          >
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={PackageReceiveIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {t('bills.addReceipts')}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            disabled={supplierId === ''}
            onClick={() => {
              setPicking('services');
            }}
          >
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={Wrench01Icon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {t('bills.addServices')}
          </Button>
          {supplierId === '' && (
            <span className="self-center text-label text-ink-3">
              {t('bills.pickSupplierFirst')}
            </span>
          )}
          <Dialog
            open={picking !== null}
            onOpenChange={(open) => {
              if (!open) setPicking(null);
            }}
          >
            <Suspense fallback={null}>
              {picking === 'receipts' && (
                <ReceiptPicker
                  supplierId={supplierId}
                  onForm={onForm}
                  addSourced={(sourced, setting) => addSourced(sourced, setting, add)}
                />
              )}
              {picking === 'services' && (
                <ServicePicker
                  supplierId={supplierId}
                  onForm={onForm}
                  addSourced={(sourced, setting) => addSourced(sourced, setting, add)}
                />
              )}
            </Suspense>
          </Dialog>
        </>
      )}
    />
  );
}

function SourceError({ message }: { message: string | undefined }) {
  const { errorText } = useLocale();
  if (message === undefined) return null;
  return (
    <span className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-label text-crit">
      <HugeiconsIcon icon={Alert02Icon} size={15} strokeWidth={1.5} className="mt-px shrink-0" />
      {errorText(message)}
    </span>
  );
}

// The lot, its dates or the serial numbers of a goods line the bill receives itself, like a goods
// receipt line (17b): posting the bill posts a goods receipt with them (decision 4). The API asks
// for them by the product's tracking, like any receipt.
function OwnGoods({
  index,
  item,
  line,
  update,
  errors,
}: {
  index: number;
  item: SalesItem;
  line: BillLineFormValues;
  update: (patch: Partial<BillLineFormValues>) => void;
  errors: {
    lotNumber: string | undefined;
    expiresOn: string | undefined;
    manufacturedOn: string | undefined;
    serialNumbers: string | undefined;
    accountId: string | undefined;
  };
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const id = (field: string) => `lines.${String(index)}.${field}`;
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-2">{t('bills.ownLine')}</span>
      <SourceError message={errors.accountId} />
      {item.tracking === 'batch' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <SalesField id={id('lotNumber')} label={t('stockLines.lot')} error={errors.lotNumber}>
            <Input
              id={id('lotNumber')}
              autoComplete="off"
              spellCheck={false}
              placeholder="NP24117"
              value={line.lotNumber ?? ''}
              invalid={errors.lotNumber !== undefined}
              onChange={(event) => {
                update({ lotNumber: event.target.value });
              }}
            />
          </SalesField>
          {(['expiresOn', 'manufacturedOn'] as const).map((date) => (
            <SalesField
              key={date}
              id={id(date)}
              label={t(`stockLines.${date}`)}
              error={errors[date]}
            >
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={id(date)} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
                <DatePicker
                  id={id(date)}
                  value={line[date] ?? ''}
                  invalid={errors[date] !== undefined}
                  onChange={(value) => {
                    update(date === 'expiresOn' ? { expiresOn: value } : { manufacturedOn: value });
                  }}
                />
              </Suspense>
            </SalesField>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {item.tracking === 'serial' && (
        <SalesField
          id={id('serialNumbers')}
          label={t('stockLines.serials')}
          error={errors.serialNumbers}
        >
          <SerialNumbersInput
            id={id('serialNumbers')}
            value={line.serialNumbers}
            invalid={errors.serialNumbers !== undefined}
            onChange={(serialNumbers) => {
              update({ serialNumbers });
            }}
          />
          <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('stockLines.serialsHint')}</span>
        </SalesField>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **"Add goods receipts" and "Add order services" need a supplier first:** the pickers list one supplier's
  documents. A line says so while none is chosen.
- **`OwnGoods` is a goods receipt line's lot, dates or serial numbers** (decision 4): posting the bill posts a goods
  receipt with them, and the API asks for them by the product's tracking like any receipt. It also shows
  `bill_account_not_allowed` (an account on a goods line), which has no box on a goods line.
- **The dates are two controlled boxes, updated one field at a time:** `date === 'expiresOn' ? { expiresOn } : {
  manufacturedOn }` keeps the patch typed; a computed key (`{ [date]: value }`) would widen it to any string key.

```tsx
import { PackageReceiveIcon, Wrench01Icon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { DialogContent, EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';

import { type BillSourcedLine, orderServiceLines, receiptBillLines } from '../lib/bill-sources';
import {
  goodsReceiptQuery,
  ordersToBillQuery,
  purchaseOrderQuery,
  receiptsToBillQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { PickButton, PickProblem } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The bill line editor's two pickers (step 17c), a chunk of their own loaded when one opens: with
// them inside, the editor's chunk was over its 100 KB budget, and most bills are typed with a
// picker opened once or not at all.

export type AddSourced = (
  sourced: readonly BillSourcedLine[],
  setting: boolean | null,
) => string | null;

// "Add goods receipts": the supplier's posted receipts with a line to bill. Each click adds what is
// left of that receipt, priced from its order. The dialog stays open: a month of deliveries from
// one mill goes on one bill.
export function ReceiptPicker({
  supplierId,
  onForm,
  addSourced,
}: {
  supplierId: string;
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>;
  addSourced: AddSourced;
}) {
  const { t, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { data: receipts } = useQuery(receiptsToBillQuery(tenantId, supplierId));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const pick = async (receiptId: string) => {
    setLoading(receiptId);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const receipt = await queryClient.query(goodsReceiptQuery(tenantId, receiptId));
      const { lines, order } = await receiptBillLines(queryClient, tenantId, receipt, onForm);
      const failed = addSourced(lines, order?.pricesIncludeVat ?? null);
      if (failed === null) setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(receiptId));
      else setProblem(failed);
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(errorText(failureOf(error instanceof Error ? error : null) ?? 'unknown_error'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('bills.receiptPickerTitle')}
      description={t('bills.receiptPickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {receipts?.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={PackageReceiveIcon}
            title={t('bills.receiptPickerEmpty')}
            description={t('bills.receiptPickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {receipts?.map((receipt) => (
              <li
                key={receipt.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {receipt.number ?? ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {isoDate(receipt.date)} ·{' '}
                    {t('bills.receiptLines', { count: receipt.lineCount })}
                    {receipt.order?.number && ` · ${receipt.order.number}`}
                    {receipt.supplierChallan && ` · ${receipt.supplierChallan}`}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(receipt.id)}
                  loading={loading === receipt.id}
                  onClick={() => void pick(receipt.id)}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}

// "Add order services": the supplier's orders with a service no posted bill bills yet; a click adds
// the order's services that are not on the form (a dyeing charge, a transport charge)
export function ServicePicker({
  supplierId,
  onForm,
  addSourced,
}: {
  supplierId: string;
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>;
  addSourced: AddSourced;
}) {
  const { t, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { data: orders } = useQuery(ordersToBillQuery(tenantId, supplierId));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const pick = async (orderId: string) => {
    setLoading(orderId);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const order = await queryClient.query(purchaseOrderQuery(tenantId, orderId));
      const services = orderServiceLines(order, onForm);
      if (services.length === 0) {
        setProblem(t('bills.noServicesLeft', { number: order.number ?? '' }));
        return;
      }
      const failed = addSourced(services, order.pricesIncludeVat);
      if (failed === null) setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(orderId));
      else setProblem(failed);
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(errorText(failureOf(error instanceof Error ? error : null) ?? 'unknown_error'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('bills.servicePickerTitle')}
      description={t('bills.servicePickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {orders?.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Wrench01Icon}
            title={t('bills.servicePickerEmpty')}
            description={t('bills.servicePickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {orders?.map((order) => (
              <li
                key={order.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {order.number ?? ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {[isoDate(order.date), order.supplierReference]
                      .filter((part) => part !== null)
                      .join(' · ')}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(order.id)}
                  loading={loading === order.id}
                  onClick={() => void pick(order.id)}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

The two dialogs, built like the invoice's challan and charge pickers: a list, an "Add" button per row that turns into
"Added", and problems shown inside the dialog. Each receipt row shows its date, how many items, its order and the
supplier's challan number, the paper the accountant holds. An order with no service left says so when it is opened,
because the list cannot tell (`noServicesLeft`).

### The bill's expenses: `components/bill-expenses.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { Alert02Icon, Delete02Icon, PlusSignIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { type Account, type BillExpenseFormValues, MAX_BILL_EXPENSES } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, CardHeader, cn, IconButton, Input, MoneyInput, Select } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { type ReactNode, useState } from 'react';
import type { FieldErrors } from 'react-hook-form';

import { draftExpenseAmounts } from '../lib/bills';
import { taxRatesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { taxRateOptions, useRateText } from '../lib/tax-rates';
import { LineError } from './journal-parts';
import { useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// A supplier bill's expenses (step 17c, decision 6): costs with no product, like rent, electricity
// or a repair. Each is an account, a description, one amount and a VAT rate. A card of its own under
// the item lines, and a lazy chunk of its own like the line editor: it brings the money box
// (decimal.js). Like the line editor, it changes one controlled array value (a Controller on
// "expenses").

export type BillExpensesErrors = FieldErrors<{ expenses: BillExpenseFormValues[] }>['expenses'];

// One template for the header and every row on a wide card; below it each box shows its label
const COLUMNS =
  '@3xl:grid-cols-[14rem_minmax(0,1fr)_8.5rem_9.5rem_7.5rem_2.25rem] @3xl:items-start @3xl:gap-2';

export function BillExpensesEditor({
  expenses,
  onChange,
  accounts,
  pricesIncludeVat,
  errors,
}: {
  expenses: BillExpenseFormValues[];
  onChange: (expenses: BillExpenseFormValues[]) => void;
  // The accounts an expense may post to (costAccounts, decision 40)
  accounts: readonly Account[];
  pricesIncludeVat: boolean;
  errors: BillExpensesErrors;
}) {
  const { t, format, errorText } = useLocale();
  const rateText = useRateText();
  const rates = useQuery(taxRatesQuery(useTenantId())).data ?? [];
  // React's keys, at the same index as the expenses: an expense keeps its key when one above it is
  // removed, so the boxes below keep what is typed in them
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<string[]>(() =>
    expenses.map((_, index) => `saved-${String(index)}`),
  );
  const listError = errors?.root?.message ?? errors?.message;
  const full = expenses.length >= MAX_BILL_EXPENSES;

  const update = (index: number, patch: Partial<BillExpenseFormValues>) => {
    onChange(expenses.map((expense, at) => (at === index ? { ...expense, ...patch } : expense)));
  };
  const remove = (index: number) => {
    setKeys((before) => before.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
    onChange(expenses.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
  };
  // A new expense starts at the workspace's default rate, like a product without its own rate
  const add = () => {
    setKeys((before) => [...before, `new-${crypto.randomUUID()}`]);
    onChange([
      ...expenses,
      {
        accountId: '',
        description: '',
        amount: '',
        taxRateId: rates.find((rate) => rate.isDefault && rate.archivedAt === null)?.id ?? '',
      },
    ]);
  };

  return (
    <Card
      className="@container grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden"
      aria-label={t('bills.expensesTitle')}
    >
      <CardHeader title={t('bills.expensesTitle')} subtitle={t('bills.expensesSubtitle')} />
      {expenses.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-5 pt-3 pb-5 text-body-sm text-ink-2">
          {accounts.length === 0 ? t('bills.noCostAccounts') : t('bills.noExpenses')}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            'mt-4 hidden bg-subtle px-5 py-2 text-caption font-medium text-ink-3 @3xl:grid',
            COLUMNS,
          )}
        >
          <span>{t('bills.expenseAccount')}</span>
          <span>{t('bills.expenseDescription')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('bills.expenseAmount')}</span>
          <span>{t('bills.expenseVat')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.amount')}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {expenses.map((expense, index) => {
        const number = index + 1;
        const rowErrors = errors?.[index];
        const id = (field: string) => `expenses.${String(index)}.${field}`;
        const rate = rates.find((each) => each.id === expense.taxRateId)?.rate ?? null;
        const amounts = draftExpenseAmounts(expense, rate, pricesIncludeVat);
        const removeButton = (
          <IconButton
            icon={Delete02Icon}
            label={t('bills.removeExpense', { number })}
            onClick={() => {
              remove(index);
            }}
          />
        );
        return (
          <div
            key={keys[index] ?? `row-${String(index)}`}
            role="group"
            aria-label={t('bills.expense', { number })}
            className={cn('grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-line px-5 py-4', COLUMNS)}
          >
            <Field
              id={id('accountId')}
              label={t('bills.expenseAccount')}
              error={rowErrors?.accountId?.message}
            >
              <Select
                id={id('accountId')}
                value={expense.accountId}
                invalid={rowErrors?.accountId !== undefined}
                options={[
                  { value: '', label: t('bills.accountPlaceholder') },
                  ...accounts.map((account) => ({
                    value: account.id,
                    label: `${account.code} · ${account.name}`,
                  })),
                ]}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  update(index, { accountId: event.target.value });
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              id={id('description')}
              label={t('bills.expenseDescription')}
              error={rowErrors?.description?.message}
            >
              <Input
                id={id('description')}
                autoComplete="off"
                placeholder={t('bills.expenseDescriptionPlaceholder')}
                value={expense.description}
                invalid={rowErrors?.description !== undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  update(index, { description: event.target.value });
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              id={id('amount')}
              label={t('bills.expenseAmount')}
              error={rowErrors?.amount?.message}
            >
              <MoneyInput
                id={id('amount')}
                value={expense.amount}
                invalid={rowErrors?.amount !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={rowErrors?.amount ? `${id('amount')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(value) => {
                  update(index, { amount: value });
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              id={id('taxRateId')}
              label={t('bills.expenseVat')}
              error={rowErrors?.taxRateId?.message}
            >
              <Select
                id={id('taxRateId')}
                value={expense.taxRateId}
                invalid={rowErrors?.taxRateId !== undefined}
                options={[
                  { value: '', label: t('salesLines.vatRate') },
                  ...taxRateOptions(rates, rateText, expense.taxRateId),
                ]}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  update(index, { taxRateId: event.target.value });
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <div className="grid content-start gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-label font-medium text-ink @3xl:sr-only">
                {t('salesLines.amount')}
              </span>
              {/* In the price's own terms, like an item line: with VAT when prices include it */}
              <span className="py-2.5 text-right text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                {amounts
                  ? format.money(pricesIncludeVat ? amounts.total : amounts.net, { decimals: 2 })
                  : '—'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end @3xl:pt-1">{removeButton}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {listError && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-line px-5 py-3 text-label text-crit">
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={Alert02Icon} size={15} strokeWidth={1.5} className="shrink-0" />
          {errorText(listError)}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line px-5 py-3">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          disabled={full || accounts.length === 0}
          onClick={add}
        >
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          {t('bills.addExpense')}
        </Button>
        {full && (
          <span className="text-label text-ink-3">
            {t('bills.tooManyExpenses', { max: MAX_BILL_EXPENSES })}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

// A box with its label, hidden on a wide card where the header names the column
function Field({
  id,
  label,
  error,
  children,
}: {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  error: string | undefined;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="col-span-2 grid grid-cols-1 content-start gap-1.5 @3xl:col-span-1">
      <label htmlFor={id} className="text-label font-medium text-ink @3xl:sr-only">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
      <LineError id={id} error={error} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

Decision 6's expenses, a card under the item lines (decision 48), and a lazy chunk like the line editor: it brings the
money box and decimal.js.

- **One controlled array value** (a `Controller` on `expenses`), like the line editor, so the form's type is the
  contract's.
- **`keys` is state at the same index as the expenses,** so an expense keeps its key when one above it is removed,
  and the boxes below keep what is typed in them. A new key is a random UUID, never reused.
- **A new expense starts at the workspace's default VAT rate,** like a product with no rate of its own.
- **"Add expense" is disabled at 100 expenses and with no account to pick;** the card says why each time, and points
  to the chart of accounts when no account can take an expense.
- **The amount column shows the line in the price's own terms,** with VAT when prices include it, like an item line.

### The bill form: `components/bill-form.tsx` and `cancel-draft-dialog.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { Button, Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, FormAlert } from '@omnivo/ui';

// "Cancel" on a numbered draft (step 17c): a bill or a payment that approvers saw keeps its number,
// so it is cancelled, never deleted (decision 13). Its own chunk, loaded when the button is
// pressed: with the dialog inside, the bill form and the payment form were over their 100 KB
// budget, and most drafts are never cancelled. The form passes its own words.
export function CancelDraftDialog({
  title,
  body,
  keep,
  confirm,
  pending,
  error,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
}: {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  // The button that closes the dialog ("Keep the bill"), never just "Cancel" beside "Cancel bill"
  keep: string;
  confirm: string;
  pending: boolean;
  // purchase_order_billed, version_conflict, … as a code
  error: string | undefined;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent
        title={title}
        description={body}
        footer={
          <>
            <DialogClose asChild>
              <Button variant="secondary">{keep}</Button>
            </DialogClose>
            <Button disabled={pending} onClick={onConfirm}>
              {confirm}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {error !== undefined && <FormAlert message={error} />}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

A numbered draft is cancelled, never deleted (decision 13). The dialog is its own chunk, shared by the bill and
payment forms (decision 55): most drafts are never cancelled. Its keep button says "Keep the bill", never "Cancel"
beside "Cancel bill".

```tsx
import {
  ArrowTurnBackwardIcon,
  Calendar03Icon,
  Delete02Icon,
  UserIcon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  type Bill,
  type BillExpenseFormValues,
  type BillFormValues,
  contractErrorMap,
  dueDateOf,
  isZeroMoney,
  levelsFor,
  type PartyRef,
  routes,
  subtractMoney,
  updateBillInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Checkbox,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  PageHeader,
  SelectField,
  TextAreaField,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Controller, type Path, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import type { BillSourcedLine } from '../lib/bill-sources';
import {
  BILL_EXPENSE_FIELDS,
  BILL_LINE_FIELDS,
  type BillLineOrigin,
  billFormTotals,
  billOrderPricing,
  billSourceIdOf,
  costAccounts,
  formPriceDifference,
  savedBillLines,
  toFormExpense,
} from '../lib/bills';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import {
  accountsQuery,
  approvalRulesQuery,
  billQuery,
  branchesQuery,
  purchaseAccountsQuery,
  stockAccountsQuery,
  supplierQuery,
  taxRatesQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';
import { serialPath } from '../lib/stock';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { PurchaseBackLink, usePurchaseRefresh } from './purchase-parts';
import { DocumentNotice, SalesTotals } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId, useWarehouses, warehouseLabel } from './stock-parts';

// The supplier bill form (step 17c): its own chunk, loaded by routes/bill.tsx, like the invoice's.
// A new bill, or a draft (a new one, or one sent back by a rejection or a reopen). "Save draft"
// keeps it a draft; the second button saves and submits it in one request (decision 14), which
// posts it at once when no approval level applies to its total, else sends it for approval.

// The line editor, the expenses card, the supplier box and the date picker are chunks of their own,
// like the invoice form's: the editors bring decimal.js with the money boxes, the boxes the popover
const BillLinesEditor = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./bill-lines')).BillLinesEditor,
}));
const BillExpensesEditor = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./bill-expenses')).BillExpensesEditor,
}));
const PartyPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./party-picker')).PartyPicker,
}));
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));
// A saved draft's approval card and the dialog of "Cancel bill" come later: the form was over its
// 100 KB budget with them inside, and both sit below the form or behind a click
const ApprovalCard = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./approval-card')).ApprovalCard,
}));
const CancelDraftDialog = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./cancel-draft-dialog')).CancelDraftDialog,
}));

type FormValues = BillFormValues;

// Every field the server may name, each line's and each expense's included, so applyApiError can
// put an error under its box
function fieldNames(values: {
  lines: readonly { serialNumbers: readonly unknown[] }[];
  expenses: readonly BillExpenseFormValues[];
}): Path<FormValues>[] {
  return [
    'supplierId',
    'supplierBillNumber',
    'date',
    'dueDate',
    'mushakNumber',
    'mushakDate',
    'branchId',
    'warehouseId',
    'pricesIncludeVat',
    'note',
    'lines',
    'expenses',
    ...values.lines.flatMap((line, index) => [
      ...BILL_LINE_FIELDS.map((field) => rowPath('lines', index, field)),
      ...line.serialNumbers.map((_, serial) => serialPath(index, serial)),
    ]),
    ...values.expenses.flatMap((_, index) =>
      BILL_EXPENSE_FIELDS.map((field) => rowPath('expenses', index, field)),
    ),
  ];
}
```

- **The editors, the supplier box, the date picker, the approval card and the cancel dialog are chunks of their
  own:** the editors bring decimal.js, the boxes the popover, and the card and dialog show below the form or behind a
  click. Without the last two, the form was 104 KB (decision 55).
- **`fieldNames` lists every field the server may name,** each line's serial numbers and each expense's fields
  included.

```tsx
export function BillForm({
  bill,
  start,
  today,
}: {
  bill: Bill | null;
  // "Make bill" on a goods receipt or an order: the supplier and the lines it starts with
  start: { supplier: PartyRef; lines: BillSourcedLine[] } | null;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { active, byId } = useWarehouses();
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data ?? [];
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const stockAccounts = useQuery(stockAccountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const purchaseAccounts = useQuery(purchaseAccountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const rates = useQuery(taxRatesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const rules = useQuery(approvalRulesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState(false);
  const [saved] = useState(() => {
    if (bill) return savedBillLines(bill);
    return {
      values: start?.lines.map((entry) => entry.line) ?? [],
      meta: start?.lines.map((entry) => entry.meta) ?? [],
      origins: new Map(start?.lines.map((entry) => entry.origin)),
    };
  });
  // Where each goods receipt line and order line on the form comes from, by its id
  const [origins, setOrigins] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, BillLineOrigin>>(saved.origins);
  const savedSupplier = bill?.supplier ?? start?.supplier ?? null;
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateBillInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      supplierId: savedSupplier?.id ?? '',
      supplierBillNumber: bill?.supplierBillNumber ?? '',
      date: bill?.date ?? today,
      // A draft's due date is kept as saved; the API filled an empty one from the terms
      dueDate: bill?.dueDate ?? '',
      mushakNumber: bill?.mushakNumber ?? '',
      mushakDate: bill?.mushakDate ?? '',
      // One branch needs no choice
      branchId: bill?.branchId ?? (branches.length === 1 ? (branches[0]?.id ?? '') : ''),
      warehouseId: bill?.warehouseId ?? '',
      // Off for a new bill: a supplier bills before VAT (the orders' setting wins, below)
      pricesIncludeVat: bill?.pricesIncludeVat ?? false,
      note: bill?.note ?? '',
      lines: saved.values,
      expenses: bill?.expenses.map(toFormExpense) ?? [],
      submit: false,
      version: bill?.version ?? 1,
    },
  });
  const lines = useWatch({ control, name: 'lines' });
  const expenses = useWatch({ control, name: 'expenses' });
  const supplierId = useWatch({ control, name: 'supplierId' });
  const date = useWatch({ control, name: 'date' });
  const dueDate = useWatch({ control, name: 'dueDate' }) ?? '';
  const ownPricing = useWatch({ control, name: 'pricesIncludeVat' });
  const supplier = useQuery({
    ...supplierQuery(tenantId, supplierId),
    enabled: supplierId !== '',
  }).data;

  // The orders' way of writing prices, else the bill's own (the API's order)
  const linePricing = billOrderPricing(lines, origins);
  const pricesIncludeVat = linePricing ?? ownPricing;
  const rateOf = (id: string) => rates?.find((rate) => rate.id === id)?.rate ?? null;
  const totals = billFormTotals(lines, expenses, rateOf, pricesIncludeVat);
  const difference = formPriceDifference(lines, origins, rateOf, pricesIncludeVat);
  // A line from a receipt or an order belongs to its supplier; a number the approvers saw keeps it
  // (the API refuses that change with purchase_supplier_invalid)
  const sourced = lines.some((line) => billSourceIdOf(line) !== null);
  const numbered = bill?.number ?? null;
  // The accounts a service line or an expense may post to, its own archived ones kept
  const choices = useMemo(
    () =>
      costAccounts(accounts ?? [], stockAccounts, [
        ...(bill?.lines.flatMap((line) => line.accountId ?? []) ?? []),
        ...(bill?.expenses.map((expense) => expense.accountId) ?? []),
      ]),
    [accounts, stockAccounts, bill],
  );
  const servicesAccount =
    accounts?.find((account) => account.id === purchaseAccounts?.services) ?? null;
  // Decision 14: "Post bill" when no level applies to the total now, else "Submit for approval"
  const needsApproval =
    levelsFor(rules?.find((rule) => rule.document === 'bill')?.levels ?? [], totals.total).length >
    0;
  const [round] = bill?.approval.rounds ?? [];
  const rejection =
    round?.status === 'rejected'
      ? round.steps.find((step) => step.decision === 'rejected')
      : undefined;
```

- **`saved` starts from the draft, or from "Make bill"'s lines** (a goods receipt's or an order's), with their meta
  and origins. It is state with an initializer, so it is worked out once, not on every render.
- **`pricesIncludeVat` starts off for a new bill:** a supplier bills before VAT. With an order behind a line, the
  orders' setting wins (`linePricing ?? ownPricing`), the API's own order.
- **`sourced` and `numbered` lock the supplier.** A line from a receipt or an order belongs to its supplier, and a
  number the approvers saw keeps it (the API refuses that change with `purchase_supplier_invalid`). The supplier box's
  hint gives the reason that applies.
- **`choices` keeps the draft's own accounts** (`costAccounts`' `keep`), memoized: the lists are rebuilt only when
  the chart or the draft changes.
- **`needsApproval` is decision 46:** the same `levelsFor` the approval card uses for a draft, on the total the form
  adds up now.

```tsx
  const save = (submit: boolean) =>
    handleSubmit(async ({ version, ...values }) => {
      try {
        const body = { ...values, submit };
        const result = bill
          ? await call(routes.bills.update, {
              params: { id: bill.id },
              body: { ...body, version },
            })
          : await call(routes.bills.create, { body });
        // Into its cache first, so the page shows it at once (posted: the view, not this form)
        queryClient.setQueryData(billQuery(tenantId, result.id).queryKey, result);
        await refresh();
        const number = result.number ?? '';
        toast(
          result.status === 'posted'
            ? t('bills.posted', { number })
            : result.status === 'pending'
              ? t('bills.submitted', { number })
              : result.number === null
                ? t('bills.draftSaved')
                : t('bills.saved', { number }),
        );
        if (!bill) {
          void navigate({ to: '/bills/$billId', params: { billId: result.id }, replace: true });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        applyApiError(error, fieldNames(getValues()), setError);
      }
    });

  const removeDraft = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: Bill) =>
      call(routes.bills.remove, { params: { id: draft.id }, query: { version: draft.version } }),
    onSuccess: async (_, draft) => {
      // To the list first: the deleted bill's own query would otherwise refetch into a 404
      await navigate({ to: '/bills' });
      queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: billQuery(tenantId, draft.id).queryKey });
      await refresh();
      toast(t('bills.deleted'));
    },
  });
  // A numbered draft is cancelled, never deleted (decision 13): its number stays in the list
  const cancel = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: Bill) =>
      call(routes.bills.cancel, { params: { id: draft.id }, body: { version: draft.version } }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      setCancelling(false);
      queryClient.setQueryData(billQuery(tenantId, result.id).queryKey, result);
      await refresh();
      toast(t('bills.cancelled', { number: result.number ?? '' }));
    },
  });

  const failure = errors.root?.server?.message ?? failureOf(removeDraft.error);
  const terms = supplier?.paymentTermsDays;
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
```

- **One `save(submit)` for both buttons** (decision 14): "Save draft" sends `submit: false`, the second button
  `submit: true`. The answer goes into the bill's cache before the refresh, so its page shows at once, the view when
  it was posted or sent for approval.
- **The toast reads the answer's status:** posted, sent for approval, saved, or a new draft with no number yet.
- **A new bill opens its page with `replace`:** Back from there goes to the list, not to an empty form.
- **Delete goes to the list before it removes the bill's query,** or the page, still open for a moment, would
  refetch the deleted draft and show "not found".

- **The supplier's bill number comes right after the supplier,** the two things on the paper the accountant checks

- **The due date's hint names the date an empty box becomes** only for a bill with no order behind a line. With an
  order, the API takes the shortest of the orders' terms (decision 39), which the form does not know, so the hint
  names no date rather than a wrong one.
- **The warehouse keeps a draft's own when it was archived since,** like a purchase order's: the API says so at
  submit, and a select that dropped it would silently clear it on the next save.
- **The checkbox shows the price setting in force,** disabled with the orders' reason when an order sets it.

### The bill's page: `components/bill-view.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { ArrowTurnBackwardIcon, Payment02Icon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  type Account,
  type Bill,
  billAmountDueOf,
  billPaymentStatusOf,
  isBillOverdue,
  isZeroMoney,
  priceDifferenceOf,
  routes,
  subtractMoney,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  FormAlert,
  PageHeader,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useState } from 'react';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { daysLate } from '../lib/invoices';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { accountsQuery, billQuery, branchesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { useRateText } from '../lib/tax-rates';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { ApprovalCard } from './approval-card';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { PurchaseBackLink, SupplierLink, usePurchaseRefresh } from './purchase-parts';
import { BillPills } from './purchase-pills';
import { SalesLinesTable } from './sales-lines-table';
import { DocumentNotice, LINK_NUMBER, LINK_ROW, LinkList, SalesTotals } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId, useWarehouses, warehouseLabel } from './stock-parts';

// What the page asks before it acts: each changes what the approvers see
type Asking = 'reopen' | 'cancel';

const accountLabel = (account: Account | undefined) =>
  account ? `${account.code} · ${account.name}` : '—';

// A supplier bill that is no longer a draft on its form (step 17c): waiting for approval, posted
// or cancelled, or a draft for someone who may not write bills. A posted bill never changes: a debit
// note corrects it (17d). What it was paid with, the advances that could pay it, and "Pay bill"
// while something is still owed. The approver reads the price difference here before deciding.
export function BillView({ bill, today }: { bill: Bill; today: string }) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const { byId } = useWarehouses();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  const can = useCan();
  const canWrite = can('purchase.bill.manage');
  const canPay = can('purchase.payment.manage');
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState<Asking | null>(null);
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  const accountOf = (id: string | null) => accounts?.find((account) => account.id === id);
  const { id, status, version, approval } = bill;
  const number = bill.number ?? '';
  const posted = status === 'posted';
  const open = posted && billPaymentStatusOf(bill) !== 'paid';
  const late = isBillOverdue(bill, today) ? daysLate(bill.dueDate, today) : 0;
  const [round] = approval.rounds;
  const rejection =
    status === 'draft' && round?.status === 'rejected'
      ? round.steps.find((step) => step.decision === 'rejected')
      : undefined;
  // The column only when a line has an order's price to differ from
  const priced = bill.lines.some((line) => line.orderValue !== null);
  const hasExpenses = bill.expenses.length > 0;

  const act = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (action: Asking) =>
      call(routes.bills[action], { params: { id }, body: { version } }),
    onSuccess: async (saved, action) => {
      setAsking(null);
      queryClient.setQueryData(billQuery(tenantId, saved.id).queryKey, saved);
      await refresh();
      toast(t(action === 'reopen' ? 'bills.reopened' : 'bills.cancelled', { number }));
    },
  });
```

- **`open` is posted and not paid in full:** only then can it be paid. `late` is how many days past its due date, for
  the overdue notice, like an invoice's.
- **`priced` adds the Price difference column only when a line has an order's price** to differ from: a bill of rent
  and services has no such column.
- **Reopen and Cancel answer with the whole bill,** which goes into its cache before the refresh.

```tsx

    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/bills" label={t('bills.back')} />
      <PageHeader

        description={bill.supplier.name}
        actions={<BillPills bill={bill} today={today} />}

          })}

      {late > 0 && (

        </DocumentNotice>
      )}
      {/* Decision 8: what posting books to the purchase price difference account */}
      {status !== 'cancelled' && !isZeroMoney(bill.priceDifference) && (
        <DocumentNotice tone="warn">
          {t('bills.priceDifferenceNotice', {
            amount: money(
              bill.priceDifference.startsWith('-')

      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">

        {bill.mushakNumber !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('bills.mushakNumber')}

                : `${bill.mushakNumber} · ${isoDate(bill.mushakDate)}`
            }
          />

        <Fact

        />
        {bill.warehouseId !== null && (

        )}
        {bill.postedAt !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('bills.statuses.posted')}
            // A moment, not a date: shown in the reader's own time zone
            value={t('bills.postedOn', { date: format.date(new Date(bill.postedAt)) })}
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <EntryLinks
            label={t('bills.entry')}
            entries={bill.entry ? [bill.entry] : []}
            none={t('bills.noEntry')}
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <>
            <Fact label={t('bills.paid')} value={money(bill.amountPaid)} />
            <Fact label={t('bills.due')} value={money(billAmountDueOf(bill))} />
          </>
        )}
        {bill.note !== null && (
          <div className="sm:col-span-3">
            <Fact label={t('bills.note')} value={bill.note} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      {bill.lines.length > 0 && (
        <SalesLinesTable
          lines={bill.lines}
          totals={hasExpenses ? null : bill}
          pricesIncludeVat={bill.pricesIncludeVat}
          note={(line) => (
            <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">
              {line.receiptNumber !== null
                ? t('bills.fromReceipt', { number: line.receiptNumber })
                : line.orderNumber !== null
                  ? t('bills.fromOrder', { number: line.orderNumber })
                  : line.accountId === null
                    ? t('bills.ownLine')
                    : null}
              {/* A service's account: the approver sees where it goes */}
              {line.accountId !== null && (
                <span className="block">
                  {t('bills.account')}: {accountLabel(accountOf(line.accountId))}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          )}
          more={
            priced
              ? {
                  headers: [t('bills.priceDifference')],
                  cells: (line) => {
                    const difference = priceDifferenceOf(line);
                    return (
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums">
                        {line.orderValue === null || isZeroMoney(difference)
                          ? '—'
                          : money(difference)}
                      </td>
                    );
                  },
                }
              : undefined
          }
        />
      )}
      {hasExpenses && <BillExpensesTable bill={bill} accountOf={accountOf} />}
      <ApprovalCard
        document="bill"
        id={id}
        number={number}
        amount={bill.total}
        draft={status === 'draft'}
        approval={approval}
      />
```

- **The notices, in the order a person reads them:** sent back, waiting or cancelled, overdue, and the price
  difference (decision 8), which the approver reads here before approving. A cancelled bill has no difference to
  book, so it says nothing about one.
- **The Mushak 6.3 number shows with its date** in one fact, the way the VAT return reads it.
- **Each line's note says where it came from, and a service's account,** so the approver sees which expense account a
  service goes to (decision 38 stored it resolved).
- **The lines table leaves out its totals when there are expenses;** the expenses table shows the bill's totals under
  both (decision 48).

```tsx
                <Link
                  to="/supplier-payments/$paymentId"
                  params={{ paymentId: payment.paymentId }}
                  className={LINK_ROW}
                >
                  <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>{payment.paymentNumber}</span>
                  <span className="text-ink-3 tabular-nums">{isoDate(payment.date)}</span>
                  <span className="ml-auto font-medium tabular-nums">{money(payment.amount)}</span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </LinkList>
        )}
        {/* Decision 12: money already paid to this supplier, this bill's orders first. It is
            applied from the payment's page, where the money is. */}
        {bill.advances.length > 0 && (
          <LinkList title={t('bills.advancesTitle')} subtitle={t('bills.advancesSubtitle')}>
            {bill.advances.map((advance) => (
              <li key={advance.paymentId}>
                <Link
                  to="/supplier-payments/$paymentId"
                  params={{ paymentId: advance.paymentId }}
                  className={LINK_ROW}
                >
                  <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>{advance.paymentNumber}</span>
                  <span className="text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {advance.order === null
                      ? isoDate(advance.date)
                      : t('bills.advanceFor', { number: advance.order.number ?? '' })}
                  </span>
                  <span className="ml-auto font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {t('bills.advanceLeft', { amount: money(advance.unapplied) })}
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </LinkList>
        )}
      </div>
```

The goods receipts, orders, payments and advances, each a list of links. The advances card (decision 12) shows only
while the bill is open and the supplier has money ahead: the bill's own orders first, as the API sends them. They are
applied from the payment's page, where the money is.

```tsx
      {canWrite && status === 'pending' && (

// The expenses, read only, with the bill's totals under them: they count the item lines too
function BillExpensesTable({
  bill,
  accountOf,
}: {
  bill: Bill;
  accountOf: (id: string) => Account | undefined;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const rateText = useRateText();
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  return (
    <Card className="overflow-hidden">
      <CardHeader title={t('bills.expensesTitle')} subtitle={t('bills.expensesSubtitle')} />
      <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] border-collapse text-body-sm">
          <caption className="sr-only">{t('bills.expensesTitle')}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-subtle text-left text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">
              <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-2.5">
                {t('bills.expenseDescription')}
              </th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-2.5">
                {t('bills.expenseAccount')}
              </th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-2.5">
                {t('bills.expenseVat')}
              </th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-2.5 text-right">
                {t('salesLines.amount')}
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {bill.expenses.map((expense) => {
              const account = accountOf(expense.accountId);
              return (
                <tr key={expense.id} className="border-t border-line align-top">
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 font-medium text-ink">{expense.description}</td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3">{accountLabel(account)}</td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {expense.taxRate.name}
                    <span className="block text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                      {rateText(expense.taxRate.rate)}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right font-medium whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums">
                    {money(bill.pricesIncludeVat ? expense.total : expense.net)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <SalesTotals totals={bill} pricesIncludeVat={bill.pricesIncludeVat} />
    </Card>
  );
}
```

- **Waiting: Cancel on the left, Reopen on the right.** The API cancels a waiting bill by reopening it first
  (decision 31); the person sees one click.
- **"Pay bill" is the cashier's button** (`purchase.payment.manage`), shown while something is owed. It opens the
  payment form with this bill applied.
- **The expenses table** shows each expense's description first: it is what the accountant typed to say what the
  money was for.

### The bill pages: `routes/bill.tsx` and `routes/bills.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import type { PartyRef } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import { PurchaseBackLink } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday, useWarehouses } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { type BillSourcedLine, orderServiceLines, receiptBillLines } from '../lib/bill-sources';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import {
  accountsQuery,
  billQuery,
  branchesQuery,
  goodsReceiptQuery,
  purchaseOrderQuery,
  taxRatesQuery,
  unitsQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';

// The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk of its own, like the
// invoice's (step 15c)
const BillForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/bill-form')).BillForm,
}));
const BillView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/bill-view')).BillView,
}));

// The units, the VAT rates, the warehouses, the branches and the accounts: the form's lines, its
// boxes and its expenses need them all, and the form's starting values read the branches
function useReady(): boolean {
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const rates = useQuery(taxRatesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const { active } = useWarehouses();
  return (
    units !== undefined &&
    rates !== undefined &&
    branches !== undefined &&
    accounts !== undefined &&
    active !== undefined
  );
}

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/bills" label={t('bills.back')} />
      <EmptyState icon={AlertCircleIcon} title={t('bills.title')} description={message} />
    </div>
  );
}

// A new bill. "Make bill" on a goods receipt comes with ?receiptId=: the form starts with what is
// left to bill on it, at its order's prices. "Make bill" on an order comes with ?orderId=: the
// order's services not billed yet.
export function NewBillPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.bill.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { receiptId = '', orderId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const start = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['purchase', tenantId, 'bill-start', receiptId, orderId],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<{ supplier: PartyRef; lines: BillSourcedLine[] }> => {
      if (receiptId !== '') {
        const receipt = await queryClient.query(goodsReceiptQuery(tenantId, receiptId));
        const { lines } = await receiptBillLines(queryClient, tenantId, receipt, new Set());
        return { supplier: receipt.supplier, lines };
      }
      const order = await queryClient.query(purchaseOrderQuery(tenantId, orderId));
      return { supplier: order.supplier, lines: orderServiceLines(order, new Set()) };
    },
    enabled: receiptId !== '' || orderId !== '',
    // Read once for this form: the next "Make bill" asks again, after whatever was billed since
    gcTime: 0,
    retry: false,
  });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <PurchaseBackLink to="/bills" label={t('bills.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('bills.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (start.isError) {
    return (
      <CantFind
        message={receiptId !== '' ? t('goodsReceipts.notFound') : t('purchaseOrders.notFound')}
      />
    );
  }
  // The form waits for the lines it starts with: drawing it empty and filling it a moment later
  // would let the person type into a form that is about to be replaced
  if (!ready || ((receiptId !== '' || orderId !== '') && !start.data)) return null;
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <BillForm bill={null} start={start.data ?? null} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function BillPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const { billId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.bill.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { data: bill, isError } = useQuery({
    ...billQuery(useTenantId(), billId),
    enabled: billId !== '',
  });

  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('bills.notFound')} />;
  if (!bill || !ready) return null;
  if (bill.status === 'draft' && canWrite) {
    // key: a saved draft comes back with a new version, and the form starts from it again
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <BillForm
          key={`${bill.id}-${String(bill.version)}`}
          bill={bill}
          start={null}
          today={today}
        />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <BillView bill={bill} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, like the invoice's. It waits for the units, the VAT rates,
the warehouses, the branches and the chart: the form's starting values read the branches, and its account boxes the
chart. "Make bill" comes with `?receiptId=` or `?orderId=`; the page waits for those lines before it draws the form,
so the form starts with them. `gcTime: 0` reads them again for the next "Make bill", after whatever was billed since.

```tsx
import { Invoice01Icon, PlusSignIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { BILL_PAYMENT_FILTERS, billAmountDueOf, type BillSummary } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  DataTable,
  dataTableColumns,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  SegmentedControl,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { SupplierFilter } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { BillPills } from '../components/purchase-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId, useToday } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { type BillListFilter, billsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

const column = dataTableColumns<BillSummary>();

// One control for what the person asks: the bills before they are posted by their status, and the
// posted ones by what is paid, like the invoice list. A bill not posted has nothing paid yet, so
// the two filters of the API never need to be set together.
const SHOW = ['', 'draft', 'pending', ...BILL_PAYMENT_FILTERS, 'cancelled'] as const;
type Show = (typeof SHOW)[number];

function filterOf(show: Show, supplierId: string): BillListFilter {
  if (show === 'draft' || show === 'pending' || show === 'cancelled') {
    return { status: show, payment: '', supplierId };
  }
  return { status: '', payment: show, supplierId };
}

// The supplier bills (step 17c), newest date first; "Not paid" and "Overdue" list the oldest due
// date first, the order they get paid in. Everyone reads them, like every purchase document;
// entering them needs purchase.bill.manage (the accountant).
export function BillsPage() {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.bill.manage');
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const today = useToday();
  const [show, setShow] = useState<Show>('');
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState('');
  const { data, isError, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage } = useInfiniteQuery(
    billsQuery(useTenantId(), filterOf(show, supplierId)),
  );
  const rows = useMemo(() => data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items), [data]);
  const loadMore = useCallback(() => {
    if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) void fetchNextPage();
  }, [hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage]);

  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      column.columns([
        column.accessor('number', {
          header: t('bills.columns.number'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'title' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid">
              {/* A draft gets its number when it is first submitted (decision 13) */}
              <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums">
                {row.original.number ?? t('bills.statuses.draft')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                {isoDate(row.original.date)}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor((bill) => bill.supplier.name, {
          id: 'supplier',
          header: t('bills.columns.supplier'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'subtitle' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid max-w-[18rem] min-w-0">
              <span className="truncate">{row.original.supplier.name}</span>
              {/* The supplier's own number, the one their accountant asks about */}
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-caption text-ink-3">
                {row.original.supplierBillNumber}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor('dueDate', {
          header: t('bills.columns.dueDate'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => <span className="tabular-nums">{isoDate(getValue())}</span>,
        }),
        column.accessor('total', {
          header: t('bills.columns.total'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          // A list shows whole taka; the bill's page shows paisa
          cell: ({ getValue }) => format.money(getValue()),
        }),
        column.accessor((bill) => billAmountDueOf(bill), {
          id: 'due',
          header: t('bills.columns.due'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          // Nothing is owed before it is posted, nor on a cancelled bill
          cell: ({ row, getValue }) =>
            row.original.status === 'posted' ? (
              <span className="font-medium">{format.money(getValue())}</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-ink-3">—</span>
            ),
        }),
        column.display({
          id: 'status',
          header: t('bills.columns.status'),
          meta: { card: 'trailing' },
          cell: ({ row }) => <BillPills bill={row.original} today={today} />,
        }),
      ]),
    [t, format, isoDate, today],
  );

  const write = canWrite && (
    <Button onClick={() => void navigate({ to: '/bills/new' })}>
      <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      {t('bills.new')}
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PageHeader title={t('bills.title')} description={t('bills.description')} actions={write} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 basis-72">
          <SupplierFilter
            id="bills-supplier"
            aria-label={t('bills.supplier')}
            value={supplierId}
            saved={null}
            onChange={setSupplierId}
            allLabel={t('suppliers.allSuppliers')}
          />
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          label={t('bills.show')}
          value={show}
          options={SHOW.map((value) => ({
            value,
            label:
              value === ''
                ? t('bills.all')
                : value === 'draft' || value === 'pending' || value === 'cancelled'
                  ? t(`bills.statuses.${value}`)
                  : t(`bills.paymentFilters.${value}`),
          }))}
          onChange={setShow}
        />
      </div>
      {isError && <p className="text-body-sm text-crit">{t('bills.loadFailed')}</p>}
      {rows && (
        <DataTable
          label={t('bills.title')}
          data={rows}
          columns={columns}
          getRowId={(row) => row.id}
          onRowClick={(row) => void navigate({ to: '/bills/$billId', params: { billId: row.id } })}
          onEndReached={loadMore}
          empty={
            <EmptyState
              icon={Invoice01Icon}
              title={t('bills.emptyTitle')}
              description={t('bills.emptyBody')}
              action={write}
            />
          }
          footer={
            isFetchingNextPage && (
              <p className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('common.loadingMore')}</p>
            )
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

The list, newest first, like the invoices': the drafts, the waiting and the cancelled by their status, the posted by
what is paid ("Not paid", "Overdue", "Paid"). A bill not posted has nothing paid, so the two API filters are never
set together. The supplier column shows the supplier's own bill number under the name. "Still to pay" shows only on a
posted bill; the list shows whole taka, the page paisa.
