```diff
+                  </td>
+                  <td className={cn(CELL, 'tabular-nums')}>{isoDate(allocation.billDate)}</td>
+                  <td className={cn(CELL, 'text-right tabular-nums')}>
+                    {money(allocation.billTotal)}
+                  </td>
+                  <td className={cn(CELL, 'text-right tabular-nums')}>
+                    {money(allocation.amount)}
+                  </td>
+                </tr>
+              ))}
+            </tbody>
+          </table>
+        </PrintBlock>
+      )}
+      {!isZeroMoney(advance) && (
+        <p className="tabular-nums">
+          {t('print.advance')}: {money(advance)}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      <Note note={payment.note} />
+    </Sheet>
+  );
+}
```

`SupplierPaymentPrint` is decision 10's voucher, from the browser like a money receipt: who was paid and how, from
which account, to which of their bank accounts with its routing number (a BEFTN transfer needs it), the amount in
words, and the bills it paid with the supplier's own bill numbers. Three signature lines: who received it, who
prepared it, who authorised it. The account's name comes from the page, which has the chart loaded already.

### The payment form: `components/supplier-payment-form.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import {
  ArrowTurnBackwardIcon,
  Calendar03Icon,
  Delete02Icon,
  UserIcon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  type Bill,
  billAmountDueOf,
  contractErrorMap,
  isMoneyAmount,
  levelsFor,
  moneyAccountIds,
  type PartyRef,
  PAYMENT_METHODS,
  plainQuantity,
  routes,
  type SupplierPayment,
  type SupplierPaymentFormValues,
  updateSupplierPaymentInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  MoneyInput,
  PageHeader,
  SelectField,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Controller, type Path, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { billAllocationRows } from '../lib/bills';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import {
  accountsQuery,
  approvalRulesQuery,
  branchesQuery,
  openBillsQuery,
  ordersToPayQuery,
  supplierPaymentQuery,
  supplierQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';
import { AllocationTable, BILL_SIDE } from './allocation-table';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { PurchaseBackLink, usePurchaseRefresh } from './purchase-parts';
import { DocumentNotice } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The supplier payment form (step 17c): its own chunk, loaded by routes/supplier-payment.tsx. A new
// payment or a draft, like the bill form: "Save draft", or save and submit in one request (decision
// 14), which posts it at once when no approval level applies to its amount. Built like the money
// receipt's form (15c), with the money going out instead of coming in.

// Both bring the popover; the delivery form says why that matters for the chunk
const PartyPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./party-picker')).PartyPicker,
}));
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));
// Like the bill form: a saved draft's approval card and the "Cancel payment" dialog come later
const ApprovalCard = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./approval-card')).ApprovalCard,
}));
const CancelDraftDialog = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./cancel-draft-dialog')).CancelDraftDialog,
}));

type FormValues = SupplierPaymentFormValues;

function fieldNames(count: number): Path<FormValues>[] {
  return [
    'supplierId',
    'date',
    'amount',
    'accountId',
    'method',
    'reference',
    'supplierBankAccountId',
    'branchId',
    'orderId',
    'note',
    'allocations',
    ...Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => [
      rowPath('allocations', index, 'billId'),
      rowPath('allocations', index, 'amount'),
    ]).flat(),
  ];
}
```

Like the bill form: the supplier box, the date picker, the approval card and the cancel dialog are chunks of their
own (decision 55; without the last two, this form was 115 KB).

```tsx
export function SupplierPaymentForm({
  payment,
  bill,
  order,
  today,
}: {
  payment: SupplierPayment | null;
  // "Pay bill": its supplier, what it still owes, applied to it
  bill: Bill | null;
  // "Pay advance" on a purchase order: its supplier, and the order it is paid against
  order: { id: string; supplier: PartyRef } | null;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data ?? [];
  const rules = useQuery(approvalRulesQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState(false);
  // The accounts money leaves from: the contracts' own list, the one the API checks against
  const moneyAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    const all = accounts ?? [];
    const ids = moneyAccountIds(all);
    return all
      .filter((account) => ids.has(account.id) || account.id === payment?.accountId)
      .toSorted((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code, undefined, { numeric: true }));
  }, [accounts, payment]);
  const savedSupplier = payment?.supplier ?? bill?.supplier ?? order?.supplier ?? null;
  const due = bill ? plainQuantity(billAmountDueOf(bill)) : '';
  const numbered = payment?.number ?? null;
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateSupplierPaymentInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      supplierId: savedSupplier?.id ?? '',
      date: payment?.date ?? today,
      amount: payment ? plainQuantity(payment.amount) : due,
      // One cash box or bank account needs no choice
      accountId:
        payment?.accountId ?? (moneyAccounts.length === 1 ? (moneyAccounts[0]?.id ?? '') : ''),
      // A supplier is mostly paid by bank: a BEFTN transfer or a cheque
      method: payment?.method ?? 'bank_transfer',
      reference: payment?.reference ?? '',
      supplierBankAccountId: payment?.supplierBankAccount?.id ?? '',
      branchId:
        payment?.branchId ??
        bill?.branchId ??
        (branches.length === 1 ? (branches[0]?.id ?? '') : ''),
      orderId: payment?.order?.id ?? order?.id ?? '',
      note: payment?.note ?? '',
      allocations:
        payment?.allocations.map((allocation) => ({
          billId: allocation.billId,
          amount: plainQuantity(allocation.amount),
        })) ?? (bill ? [{ billId: bill.id, amount: due }] : []),
      submit: false,
      version: payment?.version ?? 1,
    },
  });
  const supplierId = useWatch({ control, name: 'supplierId' });
  const amount = useWatch({ control, name: 'amount' });
  const method = useWatch({ control, name: 'method' });
  const supplier = useQuery({
    ...supplierQuery(tenantId, supplierId),
    enabled: supplierId !== '',
  }).data;
  const { data: open } = useQuery({
    ...openBillsQuery(tenantId, supplierId),
    enabled: supplierId !== '',
  });
  const orders = useQuery({
    ...ordersToPayQuery(tenantId, supplierId),
    enabled: supplierId !== '',
  }).data;
  // A draft's plan holds nothing (decision 23): the bills owe what they owe
  const rows = useMemo(
    () => billAllocationRows(open ?? [], payment?.allocations ?? [], false),
    [open, payment],
  );
  // The amount as typed, once it is an amount (one being typed, like "12.", counts as nothing)
  const typed = isMoneyAmount(amount.trim()) ? amount.trim() : '0';
  // Decision 14: "Post payment" when no level applies to the amount, else "Submit for approval"
  const needsApproval =
    levelsFor(rules?.find((rule) => rule.document === 'supplier_payment')?.levels ?? [], typed)
      .length > 0;
  const [round] = payment?.approval.rounds ?? [];
  const rejection =
    round?.status === 'rejected'
      ? round.steps.find((step) => step.decision === 'rejected')
      : undefined;
  // The supplier's bank accounts, and the draft's own if the supplier removed it meanwhile (the
  // database clears the link then, decision 33, so this is only until the next load)
  const bankAccounts = supplier?.bankAccounts ?? [];
  // The order box: the supplier's orders an advance may name (decision 44), and the draft's own
  const orderOptions = [
    ...(payment?.order && !orders?.some((each) => each.id === payment.order?.id)
      ? [{ value: payment.order.id, label: payment.order.number ?? '' }]
      : []),
    ...(orders ?? []).map((each) => ({
      value: each.id,
      label: [each.number ?? '', isoDate(each.date)].join(' · '),
    })),
  ];
```

- **"Pay bill" starts with the bill's supplier, what it owes as the amount, the bill applied, and the bill's
  branch.** "Pay advance" on an order starts with the order's supplier and the order named.
- **`moneyAccounts` is the contract's `moneyAccountIds`,** the list the API checks against, plus a draft's own
  account; one account needs no choice.
- **The method starts at bank transfer** (decision 54).
- **`rows` passes `false`:** a draft's plan holds nothing (decision 50).
- **`typed` is the amount once it is an amount:** `levelsFor` compares money, and a box being typed ("12.") is not
  money yet.
- **The supplier's bank accounts are read from the supplier** (decision 24). The order box lists the supplier's
  orders an advance may name (decision 44), and keeps a draft's own.

```tsx
  const save = (submit: boolean) =>
    handleSubmit(async ({ version, ...values }) => {
      try {
        const body = { ...values, submit };
        const result = payment
          ? await call(routes.supplierPayments.update, {
              params: { id: payment.id },
              body: { ...body, version },
            })
          : await call(routes.supplierPayments.create, { body });
        queryClient.setQueryData(supplierPaymentQuery(tenantId, result.id).queryKey, result);
        await refresh();
        const number = result.number ?? '';
        toast(
          result.status === 'posted'
            ? t('supplierPayments.posted', { number })
            : result.status === 'pending'
              ? t('supplierPayments.submitted', { number })
              : result.number === null
                ? t('supplierPayments.draftSaved')
                : t('supplierPayments.saved', { number }),
        );
        if (!payment) {
          void navigate({
            to: '/supplier-payments/$paymentId',
            params: { paymentId: result.id },
            replace: true,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        applyApiError(error, fieldNames(getValues('allocations').length), setError);
      }
    });

  const removeDraft = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: SupplierPayment) =>
      call(routes.supplierPayments.remove, {
        params: { id: draft.id },
        query: { version: draft.version },
      }),
    onSuccess: async (_, draft) => {
      await navigate({ to: '/supplier-payments' });
      queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: supplierPaymentQuery(tenantId, draft.id).queryKey });
      await refresh();
      toast(t('supplierPayments.deleted'));
    },
  });
  // A numbered draft is cancelled, never deleted (decision 13)
  const cancel = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: SupplierPayment) =>
      call(routes.supplierPayments.cancel, {
        params: { id: draft.id },
        body: { version: draft.version },
      }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      setCancelling(false);
      queryClient.setQueryData(supplierPaymentQuery(tenantId, result.id).queryKey, result);
      await refresh();
      toast(t('supplierPayments.cancelled', { number: result.number ?? '' }));
    },
  });

  const failure = errors.root?.server?.message ?? failureOf(removeDraft.error);
```

Saving, deleting and cancelling, the bill form's way.

- **Another supplier clears the bills, the bank account and the order:** each was this supplier's.

### The payment's dialogs: `components/payment-dialogs.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { Calendar03Icon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  contractErrorMap,
  type PaymentAllocationsFormValues,
  paymentAllocationsInputSchema,
  plainQuantity,
  routes,
  type SupplierPayment,
  voidSupplierPaymentInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { lazy, Suspense, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Controller, type Path, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { billAllocationRows } from '../lib/bills';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import { openBillsQuery, supplierPaymentQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { AllocationTable, BILL_SIDE } from './allocation-table';
import { usePurchaseRefresh } from './purchase-parts';
import { useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The dialogs of a posted supplier payment (step 17c), a lazy chunk of their own like the money
// receipt's (money-dialogs.tsx): "Apply money" and "Void payment". Here, not in money-dialogs.tsx:
// those refresh the sales documents and check the receipt's error codes; these refresh the
// purchase documents and check the payment's.

const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));

// "Apply money": where a posted payment's money goes, the whole list at once (decision 23: no
// approval, the money left already). An advance paid before its bill came is applied here.
export function PaymentApplyForm({
  payment,
  onDone,
}: {
  payment: SupplierPayment;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const { data: open } = useQuery(openBillsQuery(tenantId, payment.supplier.id));
  // Posted: its own amounts are in the bills' amountPaid, so they count back in, and a bill it
  // paid in full stays on the list
  const rows = useMemo(
    () => billAllocationRows(open ?? [], payment.allocations, true),
    [open, payment.allocations],
  );
  const {
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(paymentAllocationsInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      version: payment.version,
      allocations: payment.allocations.map((allocation) => ({
        billId: allocation.billId,
        amount: plainQuantity(allocation.amount),
      })),
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      const saved = await call(routes.supplierPayments.allocate, {
        params: { id: payment.id },
        body: values,
      });
      queryClient.setQueryData(supplierPaymentQuery(tenantId, saved.id).queryKey, saved);
      await refresh();
      toast(t('supplierPayments.allocated', { number: saved.number ?? '' }));
      onDone();
    } catch (error) {
      const count = getValues('allocations').length;
      const names: Path<PaymentAllocationsFormValues>[] = [
        'allocations',
        ...Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => [
          rowPath('allocations', index, 'billId'),
          rowPath('allocations', index, 'amount'),
        ]).flat(),
      ];
      applyApiError(error, names, setError);
    }
  });

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('supplierPayments.applyDialogTitle', { number: payment.number ?? '' })}
      description={t('supplierPayments.applySubtitle')}
      footer={
        <>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="secondary">{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button type="submit" form="payment-apply-form" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {isSubmitting ? t('common.saving') : t('supplierPayments.applySave')}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form id="payment-apply-form" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void onSubmit(event)}>
        {errors.root?.server?.message && <FormAlert message={errors.root.server.message} />}
        {/* The table's own padding is a card's; the dialog has its own, so it runs edge to edge */}
        <div className="-mx-[18px] sm:-mx-6">
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="allocations"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <AllocationTable
                side={BILL_SIDE}
                rows={rows}
                value={field.value}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                amount={payment.amount}
                errors={{
                  list: errors.allocations?.root?.message ?? errors.allocations?.message,
                  row: (index) =>
                    errors.allocations?.[index]?.amount?.message ??
                    errors.allocations?.[index]?.billId?.message,
                }}
                empty={t('supplierPayments.noOpenBills')}
              />
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

"Apply money" on a posted payment, the money receipt's dialog with the payment's schema, its route and its words.
Here, not in `money-dialogs.tsx`: those refresh the sales documents and check the receipt's error codes. `rows`
passes `true`: a posted payment's own amounts count back in.

```tsx
// "Void payment": the date the money turned out not to have gone (a stopped cheque, a transfer the
// bank sent back), and why. Its entry is reversed on that date and its money comes off the bills.
export function PaymentVoidForm({
  payment,
  today,
  onDone,
}: {
  payment: SupplierPayment;
  today: string;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const number = payment.number ?? '';
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(voidSupplierPaymentInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: { version: payment.version, date: today, reason: '' },
  });

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      const saved = await call(routes.supplierPayments.void, {
        params: { id: payment.id },
        body: values,
      });
      queryClient.setQueryData(supplierPaymentQuery(tenantId, saved.id).queryKey, saved);
      await refresh();
      toast(t('supplierPayments.voided', { number }));
      onDone();
    } catch (error) {
      applyApiError(error, ['date', 'reason'], setError);
    }
  });

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('supplierPayments.voidTitle', { number })}
      description={t('supplierPayments.voidBody')}
      footer={
        <>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="secondary">{t('supplierPayments.keepPayment')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button type="submit" form="payment-void-form" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {t('supplierPayments.confirmVoid')}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form
        id="payment-void-form"
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => void onSubmit(event)}
        className="grid gap-5"
      >
        {errors.root?.server?.message && <FormAlert message={errors.root.server.message} />}
        <FormField
          control={control}
          name="date"
          label={t('supplierPayments.voidDate')}
          hint={t('supplierPayments.voidDateHint')}
        >
          {(field) => (
            <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
              <DatePicker {...field} />
            </Suspense>
          )}
        </FormField>
        <TextField
          label={t('supplierPayments.voidReason')}
          placeholder={t('supplierPayments.voidReasonPlaceholder')}
          {...register('reason')}
          error={errors.reason?.message}
        />
      </form>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

"Void payment": the date the money turned out not to have gone, and why. The API refuses a date before the payment's
(`payment_void_date`), and the error shows under the date box.

### The payment's page: `components/supplier-payment-view.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { ArrowTurnBackwardIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { isZeroMoney, routes, type SupplierPayment, unappliedPaymentOf } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  FormAlert,
  PageHeader,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { accountsQuery, branchesQuery, supplierPaymentQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { ApprovalCard } from './approval-card';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { PrintButton, SupplierPaymentPrint } from './print-documents';
import { PurchaseBackLink, SupplierLink, usePurchaseRefresh } from './purchase-parts';
import { SupplierPaymentStatusPill } from './purchase-pills';
import { DocumentNotice } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The two dialogs of a posted payment as a chunk of their own, loaded when one opens: they bring
// the form library, the money boxes and the date picker, which reading a payment never needs
const PaymentApplyForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./payment-dialogs')).PaymentApplyForm,
}));
const PaymentVoidForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./payment-dialogs')).PaymentVoidForm,
}));

type Asking = 'reopen' | 'cancel';

// A supplier payment that is no longer a draft on its form (step 17c): waiting for approval,
// posted, voided or cancelled, or a draft for someone who may not write payments. A posted one can
// still be applied to other bills ("Apply money") or voided, like a money receipt (15c), and prints
// its voucher (decision 10). A voided or cancelled one stays in the list with its number.
export function SupplierPaymentView({
  payment,
  today,
}: {
  payment: SupplierPayment;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const refresh = usePurchaseRefresh();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.payment.manage');
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState<Asking | null>(null);
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<'apply' | 'void' | null>(null);
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  const { id, status, version, approval } = payment;
  const number = payment.number ?? '';
  const posted = status === 'posted';
  const unapplied = unappliedPaymentOf(payment);
  const account = accounts?.find((item) => item.id === payment.accountId);
  const accountName = account ? `${account.code} · ${account.name}` : '—';
  const bank = payment.supplierBankAccount;
  const [round] = approval.rounds;
  const rejection =
    status === 'draft' && round?.status === 'rejected'
      ? round.steps.find((step) => step.decision === 'rejected')
      : undefined;

  const act = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (action: Asking) =>
      call(routes.supplierPayments[action], { params: { id }, body: { version } }),
    onSuccess: async (saved, action) => {
      setAsking(null);
      queryClient.setQueryData(supplierPaymentQuery(tenantId, saved.id).queryKey, saved);
      await refresh();
      toast(
        t(action === 'reopen' ? 'supplierPayments.reopened' : 'supplierPayments.cancelled', {
          number,
        }),
      );
    },
  });
```

The two dialogs are one lazy chunk, loaded when one opens: reading a payment never needs the form library.

### The payment pages: `routes/supplier-payment.tsx` and `routes/supplier-payments.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import { PurchaseBackLink } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import {
  accountsQuery,
  billQuery,
  branchesQuery,
  purchaseOrderQuery,
  supplierPaymentQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';

// The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk of its own, like the
// bill's
const SupplierPaymentForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/supplier-payment-form')).SupplierPaymentForm,
}));
const SupplierPaymentView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/supplier-payment-view')).SupplierPaymentView,
}));

// The accounts and the branches: the form's starting values read them (one cash box, one branch)
function useReady(): boolean {
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  return accounts !== undefined && branches !== undefined;
}

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PurchaseBackLink to="/supplier-payments" label={t('supplierPayments.back')} />
      <EmptyState
        icon={AlertCircleIcon}
        title={t('supplierPayments.title')}
        description={message}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// A new payment. "Pay bill" comes with ?billId=: its supplier, what it still owes, applied to it.
// "Pay advance" on a purchase order comes with ?orderId=: its supplier, and the order it is paid
// against (decision 12).
export function NewSupplierPaymentPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.payment.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { billId = '', orderId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const bill = useQuery({ ...billQuery(tenantId, billId), enabled: billId !== '' });
  const order = useQuery({ ...purchaseOrderQuery(tenantId, orderId), enabled: orderId !== '' });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <PurchaseBackLink to="/supplier-payments" label={t('supplierPayments.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('supplierPayments.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (bill.isError) return <CantFind message={t('bills.notFound')} />;
  if (order.isError) return <CantFind message={t('purchaseOrders.notFound')} />;
  // The form waits for what it starts from: its boxes take their first values once
  if (!ready || (billId !== '' && !bill.data) || (orderId !== '' && !order.data)) return null;
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <SupplierPaymentForm
        payment={null}
        bill={bill.data ?? null}
        order={order.data ? { id: order.data.id, supplier: order.data.supplier } : null}
        today={today}
      />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function SupplierPaymentPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const { paymentId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.payment.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { data: payment, isError } = useQuery({
    ...supplierPaymentQuery(useTenantId(), paymentId),
    enabled: paymentId !== '',
  });

  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('supplierPayments.notFound')} />;
  if (!payment || !ready) return null;
  if (payment.status === 'draft' && canWrite) {
    // key: a saved draft comes back with a new version, and the form starts from it again
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <SupplierPaymentForm
          key={`${payment.id}-${String(payment.version)}`}
          payment={payment}
          bill={null}
          order={null}
          today={today}
        />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <SupplierPaymentView payment={payment} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

Like the bill's pages. "Pay bill" comes with `?billId=`, "Pay advance" with `?orderId=`; the form waits for that
document, so it starts with its supplier and amount.

```tsx
import { Payment02Icon, PlusSignIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_STATUSES,
  type SupplierPaymentStatus,
  type SupplierPaymentSummary,
  unappliedPaymentOf,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  DataTable,
  dataTableColumns,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  SegmentedControl,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { SupplierFilter } from '../components/purchase-parts';
import { SupplierPaymentStatusPill } from '../components/purchase-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { supplierPaymentsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

const column = dataTableColumns<SupplierPaymentSummary>();

// The supplier payments (step 17c), newest date first, like the money receipts. Everyone reads
// them; paying needs purchase.payment.manage.
export function SupplierPaymentsPage() {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const canWrite = useCan()('purchase.payment.manage');
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<SupplierPaymentStatus | ''>('');
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState('');
  const { data, isError, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage } = useInfiniteQuery(
    supplierPaymentsQuery(useTenantId(), { status, supplierId }),
  );
  const rows = useMemo(() => data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items), [data]);
  const loadMore = useCallback(() => {
    if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) void fetchNextPage();
  }, [hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage]);

  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      column.columns([
        column.accessor('number', {
          header: t('supplierPayments.columns.number'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'title' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid">
              <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums">
                {row.original.number ?? t('supplierPayments.statuses.draft')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                {isoDate(row.original.date)}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor((payment) => payment.supplier.name, {
          id: 'supplier',
          header: t('supplierPayments.columns.supplier'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'subtitle' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid max-w-[18rem] min-w-0">
              <span className="truncate">{row.original.supplier.name}</span>
              {/* The cheque or the transfer, the way the bank statement shows it */}
              <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3">
                {row.original.reference ?? row.original.supplier.code}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor('method', {
          header: t('supplierPayments.columns.method'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => t(`receipts.methods.${getValue()}`),
        }),
        column.accessor('amount', {
          header: t('supplierPayments.columns.amount'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => <span className="font-medium">{format.money(getValue())}</span>,
        }),
        column.accessor((payment) => unappliedPaymentOf(payment), {
          id: 'unapplied',
          header: t('supplierPayments.columns.unapplied'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          // An advance only counts once the money left: a draft's plan holds nothing, and a
          // voided or cancelled payment paid nothing
          cell: ({ row, getValue }) =>
            row.original.status === 'posted' ? (
              format.money(getValue())
            ) : (
              <span className="text-ink-3">—</span>
            ),
        }),
        column.accessor('status', {
          header: t('supplierPayments.columns.status'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'trailing' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => <SupplierPaymentStatusPill status={getValue()} />,
        }),
      ]),
    [t, format, isoDate],
  );

  const write = canWrite && (
    <Button onClick={() => void navigate({ to: '/supplier-payments/new' })}>
      <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      {t('supplierPayments.new')}
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PageHeader
        title={t('supplierPayments.title')}
        description={t('supplierPayments.description')}
        actions={write}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 basis-72">
          <SupplierFilter
            id="supplier-payments-supplier"
            aria-label={t('supplierPayments.supplier')}
            value={supplierId}
            saved={null}
            onChange={setSupplierId}
            allLabel={t('suppliers.allSuppliers')}
          />
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          label={t('supplierPayments.show')}
          value={status}
          options={[
            { value: '', label: t('supplierPayments.all') },
            ...SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_STATUSES.map((value) => ({
              value,
              label: t(`supplierPayments.statuses.${value}`),
            })),
          ]}
          onChange={setStatus}
        />
      </div>
      {isError && <p className="text-body-sm text-crit">{t('supplierPayments.loadFailed')}</p>}
      {rows && (
        <DataTable
          label={t('supplierPayments.title')}
          data={rows}
          columns={columns}
          getRowId={(row) => row.id}
          onRowClick={(row) =>
            void navigate({
              to: '/supplier-payments/$paymentId',
              params: { paymentId: row.id },
            })
          }
          onEndReached={loadMore}
          empty={
            <EmptyState
              icon={Payment02Icon}
              title={t('supplierPayments.emptyTitle')}
              description={t('supplierPayments.emptyBody')}
              action={write}
            />
          }
          footer={
            isFetchingNextPage && (
              <p className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('common.loadingMore')}</p>
            )
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

The list, newest first, with every status. The supplier column shows the reference under the name, the way the bank
statement shows the payment. "Not applied" shows only on a posted payment: a draft's plan holds nothing, and a voided
or cancelled payment paid nothing.


- **`billedService` is decision 30 on the page:** a posted bill billed one of the order's services, so the order is
  closed, never cancelled, and is not reopened, like an order goods came in for. A draft or waiting bill holds a
  service too; the page cannot see those, and the API refuses with `purchase_order_billed`, which the dialog shows.
- **The notice says why Reopen and Cancel are gone** (`notices.billing`).
- **Once issued, the lines table gets a Billed column,** in the base unit like Received.
- **The Bills and Advances cards** list the posted bills and the money paid ahead (decision 12). An advance shows
  what is left of it, or "All applied to bills": an advance that is all applied is history.
- **"Pay advance" and "Make bill" sit with the order's other actions** for an approved, received or closed order, each
  for its own permission. "Make bill" shows only while a service is left to bill; goods are billed from their goods
  receipts. "Receive goods" stays the one primary button, and only while the order is approved.

### Settings → Purchase accounts: `components/purchase-accounts-card.tsx` (new)

```tsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  type Account,
  contractErrorMap,
  type PurchaseAccounts,
  routes,
  updatePurchaseAccountsInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, CardHeader, FormAlert, SelectField, toast } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { accountsQuery, purchaseAccountsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

// Settings → Purchase accounts, step 17c (decision 17): where a supplier bill posts a price that
// differs from its order's, and a service line that names no account. A card of its own like the
// sales accounts of 15d: its own endpoint, its own save button.
export function PurchaseAccountsCard({
  tenantId,
  canManage,
}: {
  tenantId: string;
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const choices = useQuery(purchaseAccountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  if (!choices || !accounts) return null;
  // key: a saved form comes back with the new choices, and starts from them again
  return (
    <PurchaseAccountsForm
      key={`${choices.priceDifference ?? 'none'}-${choices.services ?? 'none'}`}
      tenantId={tenantId}
      choices={choices}
      accounts={accounts}
      canManage={canManage}
    />
  );
}

function PurchaseAccountsForm({
  tenantId,
  choices,
  accounts,
  canManage,
}: {
  tenantId: string;
  choices: PurchaseAccounts;
  accounts: readonly Account[];
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting, isDirty },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updatePurchaseAccountsInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      priceDifference: choices.priceDifference ?? '',
      services: choices.services ?? '',
    },
  });

  // Like the API (purchase_account_invalid): an active expense account that is not a group. Both
  // sit in the profit and loss. A current choice stays in the list even if it was archived since,
  // so the select shows it instead of silently moving to "None".
  const optionsFor = (current: string | null, none: string) => [
    { value: '', label: none },
    ...accounts
      .filter(
        (account) =>
          account.id === current ||
          (account.type === 'expense' && !account.isGroup && account.archivedAt === null),
      )
      .toSorted((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code, undefined, { numeric: true }))
      .map((account) => ({ value: account.id, label: `${account.code} · ${account.name}` })),
  ];

  const save = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      await call(routes.purchaseAccounts.update, { body: values });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['purchase-accounts', tenantId] });
      toast(t('settings.purchaseAccountsSaved'));
    } catch (error) {
      applyApiError(error, ['priceDifference', 'services'], setError);
    }
  });

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t('settings.purchaseAccountsTitle')}
        subtitle={t('settings.purchaseAccountsSubtitle')}
      />
      <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void save(event)} className="grid gap-5 p-5">
        {errors.root?.server?.message && <FormAlert message={errors.root.server.message} />}
        {/* Read only without core.settings.manage: everyone may see where bills are booked */}
        <fieldset disabled={!canManage} className="grid gap-5">
          <SelectField
            label={t('settings.priceDifferenceAccount')}
            hint={t('settings.priceDifferenceAccountHint')}
            options={optionsFor(choices.priceDifference, t('settings.priceDifferenceAccountNone'))}
            {...register('priceDifference')}
            error={errors.priceDifference?.message}
          />
          <SelectField
            label={t('settings.servicesAccount')}
            hint={t('settings.servicesAccountHint')}
            options={optionsFor(choices.services, t('settings.servicesAccountNone'))}
            {...register('services')}
            error={errors.services?.message}
          />
        </fieldset>
        {canManage && (
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={isSubmitting || !isDirty}>
              {isSubmitting ? t('common.saving') : t('settings.purchaseAccountsSave')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

Decision 17's two accounts, a card of its own like the sales accounts: its own endpoint, its own save button, read
only without `core.settings.manage`. Each select lists what the API accepts (an active expense account that is not a
group), keeps a current choice archived since, and its empty option says what an empty box means: the price
difference goes to Cost of goods sold; services have no fallback. The form's `key` holds both choices, so a saved form
starts from what was saved.

The six new routes. `/…/new` beats `/…/$id`, like every document. The `validateSearch` functions keep only a real id,
so a hand-typed `?billId=x` opens an empty form instead of a failed request.

```diff
+// step adds its own, so 17c's words alone took it to 200.7 KB. Loading each module's words with

+// from growing the first load unnoticed.
```

Decision 55. The comment says why the number moved and what the real fix is, so the next person who raises it knows
it was a choice, not a slip.

The fixtures: an order line of 40 bags of 30s yarn (a bag is 50 kg) at ৳7,800 a bag with ৳2,000 off, and a goods

```ts
describe('a goods receipt line on a bill', () => {
  it("starts at the order's price, moved to the receipt line's unit", () => {
    const line = receiptLineToBill(receiptLine(), orderLine());
    expect(line).toMatchObject({
      variantId: 'yarn',
      unitId: 'kg',
      quantity: '800',
      receiptLineId: 'receipt-line-1',
      // The API reads the order line from the receipt line; both on one line is bill_line_source
      orderLineId: '',
      // ৳7,800 a bag of 50 kg is ৳156 a kg
      unitPrice: '156.0000',
      discountType: 'amount',
      // The share of the order's ৳2,000 off that 800 of its 2,000 kg carry
      discount: '800',
      taxRateId: 'vat-15',
      // The product's own name stays an empty box, so a renamed product is followed
      description: '',
    });
  });

  it('keeps a percent discount as it is, and leaves the price empty without an order line', () => {
    const percent = orderLine({ discountType: 'percent', discount: '5.0000' });
    expect(receiptLineToBill(receiptLine(), percent).discount).toBe('5');
    expect(receiptLineToBill(receiptLine(), undefined)).toMatchObject({
      unitPrice: '',
      taxRateId: '',
    });
  });

  it('knows what the goods receipt booked, and finds no difference at the same price', () => {
    expect(receiptOrderValue(receiptLine(), orderLine())).toBe('124000.0000');
    const line = receiptLineToBill(receiptLine(), orderLine());
    const origins = new Map([
      [
        'receipt-line-1',
        {
          receiptNumber: 'GRN-2026-27-0007',
          orderNumber: 'PO-2026-27-0003',
          pricesIncludeVat: false,
          orderValue: '124000.0000',
        },
      ],
    ]);
    expect(formPriceDifference([line], origins, rateOf, false)).toBe('0.0000');
    // The mill billed ৳157 a kg: ৳800 over the order (800 kg × ৳1)
    expect(formPriceDifference([{ ...line, unitPrice: '157' }], origins, rateOf, false)).toBe(
      '800.0000',
    );
  });

  it('leaves out what is billed, what accepted nothing, and what the form holds', () => {
    const lines = [
      receiptLine({ id: 'a' }),
      receiptLine({ id: 'b', billed: true }),
      // Everything turned back at the gate: nothing to bill (decision 43)
      receiptLine({ id: 'c', quantity: '0.0000', baseQuantity: '0.0000' }),
      receiptLine({ id: 'd' }),
    ];
    expect(receiptLinesLeft(lines, new Set(['d'])).map((line) => line.id)).toEqual(['a']);
  });
});

describe("an order's services on a bill", () => {
  it('offers only the services no posted bill bills, and not what the form holds', () => {
    const lines = [
      orderLine({ id: 'goods' }),
      orderLine({ id: 'dyeing', productType: 'service' }),
      orderLine({ id: 'transport', productType: 'service', billedQuantity: '1.0000' }),
      orderLine({ id: 'washing', productType: 'service' }),
    ];
    expect(servicesLeft(lines, new Set(['washing'])).map((line) => line.id)).toEqual(['dyeing']);
  });
});
```

- **The price moves to the receipt line's unit** (৳156 a kg) and the amount discount goes with the share 800 of 2,000
  kg carry (৳800).
- **At the order's price the difference is ৳0,** and at ৳157 a kg it is ৳800: the API's own sums on both sides.
- **The lines left to bill leave out** a billed line, a line that accepted nothing and a line on the form.

```ts
      account('4100', { type: 'income' }),
```

## 17c.7 — `apps/app`: the mock API and the end-to-end tests

`pnpm dev:mock` and the Playwright tests run the app on MSW, the fake API inside the browser (step 4). This part
teaches the mock every route of 17c, with the API's rules, shortened: bills and their posting, supplier payments and
what they apply, the purchase accounts in Settings, what a goods receipt and a purchase order know about their
bills, and the approval engine that posts a bill or a payment at its last approval. Then one new test file clicks
through the screens of 17c.6 on a desktop and on a phone.

When this part starts, the app's type check has 6 errors, all in `src/mocks/`: the mock still sends the shapes of
17b. After this part it has none, and `pnpm --filter @omnivo/app build` passes again.

This was also the first time the 17c.6 screens ran in a browser. They worked as written. One thing outside the app
showed up: `pnpm boundaries`, which had not run since 17c.2, found the two database schema files that import each
other (decision 59). Decisions 56–59, at the top of this guide, came up while building this part.

The files, in the order to write them: each one only uses files above it.

```diff
+    purchase_order: () => data.purchase.orders.find((item) => item.id === id),
+    bill: () => data.purchase.bills.find((item) => item.id === id),

+// What posts a bill or a payment when its last approval is given (decision 7). bill-data.ts
+// registers them when it loads, like the API's services call approvals.onApproved() in their
+// constructors: this file cannot import bill-data.ts, which imports it.
+type Poster = (data: WorkspaceData, id: string) => void;
+const posters = new Map<ApprovalDocument, Poster>();
+
+export function onApproved(document: ApprovalDocument, post: Poster): void {
+  posters.set(document, post);
+}
+
+// The poster's error is the approval's: the handler runs decide() in a transaction(), so a bill
+// in a closed period leaves its round waiting, like the API's (decision 36)
+function postApproved(data: WorkspaceData, document: ApprovalDocument, id: string): void {
+  const post = posters.get(document);
+  if (!post) throw new Error(`Nothing posts a ${document} on approval`);
+  post(data, id);
+}
```

- **`ApprovalTarget` is a union with a flag** (`posts`). A requisition or an order becomes "approved"; a bill or a
  payment has no such status (decision 7) and is posted instead. With the flag, TypeScript knows which statuses
  each side may get: `setStatus()` keeps its type (the statuses a requisition and an order share), and a bill can
  never be set to "approved" by mistake.
- **A rejection sends a bill or a payment back to draft** with a new version, like a requisition. Its number stays,
  so the approver's comment and the next round belong to the same document.
- **The last approval runs the poster** that `handlers.ts` registered (decision 56). No poster is a programming
  mistake, not a user's, so it throws a plain `Error`.
- **`waitingSubject()` finds an order, a bill or a payment in one list:** all three name their supplier and their
  number, and a document that waits always has a number (submitting gives it one).

- **A posted bill's line counts next to the agreed orders** (decision 25). The bills go first in the list, so on the
  same date the bill wins over its order, like the API's `created_at`: a bill is written after its order, and it
  says what the supplier really charged.

- **An order's bills, advances and billed quantities are not stored** (decision 29): a bill posted a second ago
  shows on its order at once. The order line type leaves out `billedQuantity` for the same reason.
- **A receipt keeps `orderId` or `billId`,** never both: the API's `goods_receipts_source_check`. One made by a bill
  has no order (decision 21).

What bills did, worked out on read:

```diff
@@ -122,6 +143,62 @@ function goodsToReceive(order: MockPurchaseOrder): boolean {

+// --- What bills did (step 17c) -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+// The posted bills whose lines pass the test, oldest first, as references. A posted bill always
+// has its number.
+function postedBillsOf(
+  data: WorkspaceData,
+  test: (line: { receiptLineId: string | null; orderLineId: string | null }) => boolean,
+): DocumentRef[] {
+  return data.purchase.bills
+    .filter((bill) => bill.status === 'posted' && bill.lines.some(test))
+    .toSorted((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
+    .map((bill) => ({ id: bill.id, number: bill.number }));
+}
+
+// What posted bills billed of an order line, in its base unit: a receipt line's bill line keeps
+// its order line too, so goods and services count the same way (the API's billedQuantities)
+function billedOf(data: WorkspaceData, orderLineId: string): string {
+  return sumQuantity(
+    data.purchase.bills
+      .filter((bill) => bill.status === 'posted')
+      .flatMap((bill) => bill.lines)
+      .filter((line) => line.orderLineId === orderLineId)
+      .map((line) => line.baseQuantity),
+  );
+}
+
+// An order's service line no posted bill bills yet. Goods are billed from their goods receipts.
+function serviceToBill(data: WorkspaceData, line: MockPurchaseOrderLine): boolean {
+  return line.productType === 'service' && isZeroQuantity(billedOf(data, line.id));
+}
+
+// "Services to bill" (decision 22): approved, received or closed (the job was done before the
+// order was closed), with a service no posted bill bills yet
+function servicesToBill(data: WorkspaceData, order: MockPurchaseOrder): boolean {
+  return (
+    ['approved', 'received', 'closed'].includes(order.status) &&
+    order.lines.some((line) => serviceToBill(data, line))
+  );
+}
+
+// A bill that is not cancelled, even a draft, bills one of the order's services (decision 30):
+// reopened, the order would write its lines again under the bill's; cancelled, the bill would
+// bill a service nobody ordered. The API's assertNotBilled().
+function assertNotBilled(data: WorkspaceData, order: MockPurchaseOrder): void {
+  const ids = new Set(order.lines.map((line) => line.id));
+  const billed = data.purchase.bills.some(
+    (bill) =>
+      bill.status !== 'cancelled' &&
+      bill.lines.some(
+        (line) =>
+          line.receiptLineId === null && line.orderLineId !== null && ids.has(line.orderLineId),
+      ),
+  );
+  if (billed) throw conflict('purchase_order_billed');
+}
```

- **`billedOf()` counts posted bill lines by their order line.** A receipt line's bill line keeps the order line too
  (17c.2), so goods and services are counted the same way. A draft bill counts nothing: it holds nothing (decision
  29).

  closed order is still in the list: the dyeing was done before the order was closed.
- **`assertNotBilled()` counts every bill that is not cancelled, drafts too** (decision 30). It is the API's
  `purchase_order_billed`: reopening the order would write its lines again under the bill's.
- **The advances are the order's posted payments,** oldest first. A draft payment has not paid yet, and a voided one
  paid nothing.

```diff
+function billStateOf(stored: MockGoodsReceipt): GrnBillState {
```

- **`toBill()` is a line still to bill:** not billed, and something was accepted. A line that turned everything back
  has nothing to bill (decision 43).
- **`billStateOf()` is the API's `CASE`:** a draft, or a posted receipt with no billed line, is "Not billed"; billed
  lines next to lines still to bill are "Partly billed".
- **"Billed" in the list's filter means every line is done,** the same words the pill uses, so the filter and the
  pill never disagree.
- **`order` is `null` for a receipt a bill made,** and `bill` names that bill; the page shows "Received by
  BILL-…" instead of an order.

```diff
+  const moved = moveIn(
```
